22f2cca855bfe932f65c.description:
Responsibilities:

The **Scheduling Coordinator** assists in participant care responsibilities by performing receptionist duties, escorting participants to exam rooms and scheduling and coordinating various appointments between the participant and providers. The Scheduling Coordinator also performs a variety of clerical duties and provides administrative support to all clinic functions.

**Essential Functions and Work Responsibilities**

**Functional Category: Participant Scheduling and Support**

**Estimated Percent of time Spent – 50%**

* Schedule appointments with external network specialists for consultations and procedures as ordered by PACE Primary Care Physicians (PCPs).
* Prioritize appointment scheduling based on Expected By Date and clinical urgency as directed by medical staff.
* Collaborate daily with clinical teams to manage participant flow and ensure timely access to care.
* Meet or exceed scheduling productivity standards set.
* Ensure all appointment data and updates are accurately documented in Epic (electronic medical record).
* Serve as a liaison between participants, caregivers, providers, and external specialist offices to coordinate care and resolve scheduling conflicts.
* Notify participants and families of appointment details, including date, time,
* Provide attentive, responsive, and professional service during all participant and provider interactions.
* Scheduling high complex medical appointments between participants and specialty providers.
* Coordinating referrals and specialty care services.
* Obtaining and tracking consultation notes and diagnostic testing results.
* Managing clinic-based scheduling workflows and participant care coordination activities.
* Performing front-office clinic support functions such as participant check-in and appointment management.
* Preparing and coordinating authorizations related to specialty referrals and services.
* Documenting scheduling activities and participant interactions within an EMR to support and maintain the participant's medical record.

**Functional Category: Internal Collaboration & Compliance**

**Estimated Percent of time Spent – 50%**

* Collaborate closely with the Interdisciplinary Team (IDT), Transportation Department, Adult Day Health Center (ADHC), and clinic staff to coordinate appointments, ensure appropriate support services are arranged, and align scheduling with participant care plans and operational priorities.
* Participating in IDT meetings as appropriate to communicate scheduling updates, identify access barriers, and support timely resolution of participant care needs.
* Coordinate proactively with internal departments to manage schedule changes, transportation adjustments, medically necessary escorts, and coverage needs to prevent service disruptions.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in Epic to ensure all departments have visibility into appointment details, changes, and care coordination efforts.
* Support internal audits, quality reviews, and process improvement initiatives as directed to ensure compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and productivity standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Regional Scheduling Manager

**Travel Requirements**

**Travel**: N/A

**Qualifications**

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**REQUIRED**

Work Experience and Qualifications:

* 1+ yr administrative, clerical experience, and medical administrative experience that includes filing, record keeping, data entry and providing customer service
* 1+ yr scheduling experience
* Must have recent medical scheduling experience within the last 1-2 years of employment
* 3-5 years of customer service experience
* Remote work experience
* Medical Terminology
* EMR

**PREFERRED**

Work Experience and Qualifications

* Clinic health care experience in a geriatrics setting
* Experience as a Nursing Assistant in home care, long-term care, daycare or group home
* Using Epic EMR

Benefits:

InnovAge is dedicated to empowering seniors to live independently, allowing them to age in their own homes and communities safely. InnovAge offers an alternative to nursing homes through its Program of All-inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), which provides enrolled seniors with customized healthcare and social support at PACE Adult Day Health Centers. These centers are staffed by medical professionals who are committed to creating personalized care plans for each participant. At InnovAge, our team members are our greatest asset and have a significant impact on the lives of our participants every day. When you join InnovAge, you'll work alongside talented, respectful, and passionate colleagues within a patient-centered care model.

InnovAge is committed to equal opportunity and affirmative action, and we strive to create a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified candidates for employment without discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, or any other protected status. Salaries are determined by various factors such as qualifications, experience, and location, and do not include potential bonuses or benefits. Our extensive benefits package includes medical/dental/vision insurance, short and long-term disability, life insurance and AD&D, supplemental life insurance, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) savings, paid time off, and company-paid holidays.

Applicants are considered until the position is filled.

Posted Pay Range: $19.76 - $22.74 Additional Information:

**Project Coordinator I: Project Management & Client Support – (CA, AZ, & MA)**

**About iQ Biosciences**

iQ Biosciences (iQ) is a specialized preclinical research partner dedicated to helping drug developers ask the right questions early to generate meaningful data and make confident decisions throughout development. Since 2014, our immunology expertise, coupled with our agility, drive, and collaborative approach, has made us the partner of choice for research organizations of all sizes and across a range of therapeutic areas. iQ offers an integrated, scientist-led model that combines three core capabilities – high-quality cellular products, in vitro bioservices, and custom bioconjugation – and a commitment to being as passionate about its clients' research as they are.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Senior Project Manager, the Project Coordinator I supports the successful delivery of scientific projects and contributes to inside-sales activities. This entry-level role will work closely with the Senior Project Manager and cross-functional scientific and operational teams to keep projects organized, communications timely, and client records current.

The position is designed for someone who is organized, client-focused, and wants to build a career in biotechnology project management, client services, or inside sales. Responsibilities may shift based on business needs and the employee’s strengths, interests, and demonstrated capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive project planning, execution, tracking, and closeout under the guidance of the Senior Project Manager.
* Track timelines, milestones, client materials, deliverables, action items, and follow-up needs. Surface any process gaps and identify corrective workflow processes.
* Coordinate with scientific, operational, business development, and finance teams to support timely project execution.
* Draft professional client communications and prepare proposals, project documents, and other client-facing materials.
* Coordinate internal and client meetings, including scheduling, agendas, decisions, and action items. Summarize key information in after action-reports and confirm understanding across stakeholders, utilizing background knowledge of scientific needs.
* Own invoicing, documentation review, deliverable tracking, and project closeout.
* Maintain accurate project, client, lead, and opportunity information in CRM and project-tracking systems.
* Follow up on inquiries and proposals, help qualify opportunities, and support existing client relationships.
* Develop project management training materials, tools, processes, and SOPs.
* Have ownership of projects as experience and proficiency grow.
* Provide additional project management, client service, inside sales, or administrative support based on business needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in biology, immunology, or a closely related life-science field.
* Interest in progressing in project management, client account support, or inside sales role.
* At least 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing role. Relevant experience may come from biotechnology, a contract research organization, hospitality, restaurants, or another service-oriented environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Confidence interacting with clients and internal stakeholders in a professional and service-oriented manner.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Who You Are**

* **Eager to learn:** You are curious, receptive to feedback, and motivated to continually build your scientific and project management knowledge.
* **Passionate about the science:** You enjoy understanding the scientific rationale behind each project and how the work supports the client’s broader goals.
* **Accountable:** You take ownership of your responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and communicate early when something may affect scope, timing, or deliverables.
* **Proactive:** You anticipate next steps, identify potential risks or gaps, and take action before they become larger issues.
* **Organized:** You can manage multiple projects, priorities, timelines, and follow-up items while maintaining attention to detail.
* **Detail-oriented:** You consistently produce accurate, thorough work and carefully review project details, pricing, documentation, and communications before they are finalized.
* **Collaborative:** You work effectively with scientific, operational, business development, and finance teams to keep projects moving.
* **Clear communicator:** You communicate thoughtfully and professionally, adapting the level of detail for clients and internal teams.
* **Adaptable:** You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where project needs, timelines, and priorities may change.

**General Information**

* Full-time, exempt position.
* Candidates **may be based in California, Arizona, or Massachusetts only.** On-site/hybrid in Alameda, CA preferred. Remote work from California, Arizona, or Massachusetts will be considered.
* Relocation assistance: No
* Occasional travel of 10%-15% may be required for conferences, client meetings, or company activities.
* Schedule: Based on location. Must be able to overlap hours to PST operating hours. Occasional night or weekend work may be required.
* Compensation: Range $60,000 to $83,000 annually, based on location/experience.
* Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with employer match after the introductory period, paid holidays, PTO, EAP, life and long-term disability insurance, FSA with employer contribution, and company-provided lunch/snacks.

This job description outlines the position's primary duties and requirements. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to support the goals and objectives of the organization.

**Who Are We?**

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 160 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.

**Our Impact**

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4,500 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don’t just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

**Our Vision**

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

**Are You Ready?**

This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what’s possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let’s explore this journey together.

**Check us out here:** **Decentralized Masters**  
  
**The Role**  
Decentralized Masters is looking for an Affiliate & Partnerships Coordinator to own the day-to-day operations of our affiliate and partnership program. The program spans affiliate networks, newsletter and media placements, and creator partnerships. This is an execution-focused role. You'll set up tracking, keep partner placements and copy current, run compliance checks, and produce the weekly reporting that keeps the program accountable.

You don't need to be an elite affiliate strategist to do this well. The focus is execution and consistency: taking over the operational workflow and keeping it running cleanly. You'll work closely with the Head of Partnerships, who owns strategy and partner relationships. Your job is to make the machine run.  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Link & tracking setup: Create and manage affiliate tracking links and offers in Everflow. Make sure attribution is configured correctly and firing end to end.
* Partner copy & updates: Manage and update creative and copy for partner placements. Keep offers, links, and assets current across all partners.
* Creator & media partnerships: Help source and coordinate placements with newsletters, YouTube and podcast channels, and other media and creator partners. Brief them on messaging and compliance, hand over tracking links and creative, schedule go-lives, and chase deliverables so campaigns launch on time.
* Compliance checks: Review partner copy and placements against our compliance guardrails before anything goes live. This is a regulated space, so accuracy and defensibility matter.
* Reporting: Produce detailed weekly performance reports across partners and affiliates. Surface what's working, what isn't, and where attribution is breaking.
* Analysis: Read performance data (spend, ROAS, CPA, conversion) and flag issues, opportunities, and anomalies.

fc1c07a228e4854f2e8e.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:** The full-time Medical Department Credentialing Coordinator serves and advocates for clinicians and provides administrative support to the Medical and Quality Assurance Departments. He/she serves as Credentialing Manager for Esperanza, coordinates provider on and off-boarding and manages the department budget.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Credentialing**

* Guide clinicians (and other licensed professional staff including BHC, Dentists, Nurses, and Dieticians) through the credentialing, privileging, and re-credentialing processes.
* Internal Credentialing
  + Request, gather, and maintain on file all relevant documentation for internal and external provider/staff credentialing
  + Create, maintain, and update credentialing reports and spreadsheets.
* Governmental Licensing
  + Coach clinicians in how and when to apply for licenses.
  + Submit initial supervision agreements (PA’s) and prescriptive authority applications (CRNP’s) for midlevel practitioners with state medical and nursing boards. Take lead in keeping up to date with changing requirements.
  + Maintain on file collaborative agreements for CRNP’s.
  + Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new clinicians with Medicaid and Medicare.
* Insurance/External Privileging
  + Prepare and submit privileging applications for new clinicians with insurance companies.
  + Request and maintain hospital privileges for applicable clinicians.
  + Maintain a filing system that allows for timely retrieval of requested information.
  + Keep a constant flow of communication between the insurance companies, hospitals, malpractice companies and medical billing agencies, to ensure EHC is in compliance with all state, city and federal regulations.
  + Research and resolve any and all credentialing issues.
  + Update and inform Medical Director, Dental Director, Behavioral Health Director, HR Director, Executive Director, and Billing Manager of any issues, changes in policies and/or provider status changes that may arise unexpectedly.
  + Keep a professional and friendly relationship with all network representatives.
* Re-credentialing
  + Manage the internal re-privileging process for clinicians and other licensed professional staff every two years (concurrent with the renewal date of providers’ licenses).
  + Create and maintain Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) profiles for billable practitioners in coordination with the Dental and BHC departments.
* Support clinician completion of continuing medical education requirements and reimbursements within Esperanza guidelines.

**Medical Director and Clinician Leadership Support**

* Support projects of Medical Director, Site Medical Directors and Associate Medical Directors as needed and as available.
* Know and communicate Medical Department policy to clinicians and staff when appropriate. Assist with drafting, editing, compiling, and formatting medical department policy and procedure.

**Clinician Support**

* Provide spiritual support, encouragement to clinician staff as needed
* Take initiative to check in with clinicians (especially at K&A), advocate for clinician wellbeing and concerns, and work toward resolution of any problems that arise.
* Respond to clinician communication in a timely fashion.
* Coordinate ACLS and BLS training for medical clinicians every 2 years.

**Human Resources**

* Participate in clinician screening and interviewing.
* Occasionally assist with clinician recruiting at conferences, career fairs, and other events.
* Communicate in a timely fashion with HR about clinician start dates, FMLA’s, leaves, and FTE changes.
* Coordinate and plan staff retreats with HR, as needed.
* Coordinate onboarding for oncoming clinicians, communicating with HR, IT and appropriate departments
* Coordinate exit process for departing clinicians including sending farewell letters to patients, scheduling a goodbye dinner, communicating with HR and appropriate departments, and overseeing patient reassignment in collaboration with Medical Department Administrator.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Help to cover tasks during absences of Medical Department Administrator.
* Coordinate tracking and maintenance of Athena Billable license count, working with IT and Finance to ensure that appropriate number of licenses are maintained
* Coordinate access to external EMR systems

**Budget Management**

* Manage departmental budget, track expenses, and ensure timely reimbursements.
* Prepare monthly credit card usage report.
* Project department expenses for annual budget proposal.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Demonstrates Godly character and lifestyle in keeping with authority of the Bible
* Self-directed and motivated.

* Exceptional organizational and interpersonal skills, with attention to detail required.

* Independent thinker and good problem-solver.
* Strong oral/written communication is required. Establishes and maintains open lines of communications with other staff.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team and manage multiple priorities, utilize effective time management skills, and exercise sound administrative judgment.
* Ability to analyze systems and to develop creative solutions to problems.
* Demonstrated ability to work well with people of various ages, backgrounds, ethnicities, and life experiences.
* Mature, well-spoken. Maintains discretion and confidentiality in communicating with others.
* Wisdom and courage to evaluate candidates in a way that preserves Esperanza’s mission and honors and respects those who may not be good fits.
* Communicates the love of Christ through interactions, not complaining or arguing, but expressing hope in Christ and His promises.
* Seeks to serve Christ and proclaim the gospel in word and deed.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* NAMSS certification preferred.
* At least 1-2 years of administrative experience preferred.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
* Experienced with MS Word and Excel.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Must be able to work in regular office environment.

**Service Operations Coordinator - Scheduling, Dispatch & Administration**

**Oley, PA/Full Time**

Mast Roofing & Construction in Oley, PA is seeking a full-time Service Operations Coordinator to keep our phones, appointment schedules, dispatch activities, and service administration running accurately and efficiently. This is a Client Care Representative position with substantial responsibility for coordinating the work behind every client interaction and helping turn incoming opportunities into completed, profitable work.

Answering a high volume of incoming calls is a central part of this role. Success also requires active thinking, independent judgment, and timely decisions. You will move between live calls, scheduling changes, technician needs, payments, and detailed administrative work throughout the day. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, anticipates problems, and follows through without waiting for repeated direction.

Annual earning potential is $45,000–$65,000, with a starting base of $22/hour+, DOE (depending on experience), plus performance incentives and bonus opportunities. Benefits include personalized training, paid holidays including your birthday, paid time off (PTO), medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, and an IRA retirement plan with a 100% company match up to 3%.

Are you quick-thinking, highly organized, and accurate under pressure? Can you listen closely, ask the right questions, and enter information directly into a computer system while keeping a conversation moving? If you enjoy solving scheduling problems, managing competing priorities, and taking ownership of results, we would like to meet you.

**ABOUT MAST ROOFING & CONSTRUCTION**

We are a faith-based, family-run, full-service residential and light commercial roofing and construction company. For over 28 years, we have built our reputation by caring for our clients and delivering quality workmanship through expert training, technology, and industry experience.

Our mission is simple: To honor God by serving those around us with excellence. Our Core Values — W.I.S.E. — guide how we work: Work Hard, With Integrity, Serving Others, and With Excellence. We value our employees and their families and encourage personal growth, skill development, and a positive, professional culture of ownership and accountability.

**A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A SERVICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**

You help set the pace for the day. You answer calls, identify client needs, book appointments, and keep the CRM current as conversations happen. You coordinate with sales and production, adjust schedules as priorities change, and help technicians arrive prepared. Between calls, you prepare production folders, process payments, track appointment outcomes, and make sure the next person has the information needed to do the job well.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

Handle a high volume of incoming calls with professionalism, urgency, and accuracy. Work toward answering 98% of calls by the third ring and use a headset throughout the work shift to support efficient call handling.

Maintain a minimum 80% booking ratio by using approved scripts, asking effective questions, explaining the value of our services, and addressing objections confidently and respectfully.

Listen and type client information directly into the CRM during live conversations, without relying on handwritten notes for later entry. Capture contact details, service needs, commitments, and next steps completely and accurately.

Respond to online quote requests within 5 minutes of submission, return client calls within 5 minutes, and respond to emails, texts, and calls daily in accordance with company procedures.

Schedule repair and replacement appointments, service calls, estimates, and final 25 Point roof inspections. Confirm appointment details, start dates, times, and any changes promptly with clients and the appropriate staff.

Coordinate and dispatch repair inspections and production calls under the direction of the Production Manager. Make proactive scheduling decisions within established guidelines to support profitable dispatching, productive technician time, efficient travel, and timely client service.

Monitor the schedule for gaps, conflicts, delays, and changing priorities. Take action to keep appointments moving, communicate adjustments, and escalate decisions that exceed your authority.

Generate sales orders in the CRM, record and verify appointment results, and follow up with the responsible staff when results or supporting details are missing. Keep administrative tracking systems updated daily.

Prepare complete, accurate production and job folders, including jobs with signed proposals and deposits awaiting contracts. Ensure repair and replacement paperwork reaches the appropriate staff before appointments.

Route required job pouches to management for commission entry and review. Transfer completed job folders to the Office Manager for invoicing and send contracts for electronic signatures as directed.

Collect required payments and payment information on booked and confirmed calls, following company procedures for authorization, accurate processing, documentation, and protection of client information.

Assist clients who choose financing and complete vendor warranty registrations after final invoicing. Track outstanding documents and follow through until required administrative steps are complete.

Provide prompt support to technicians and sales representatives. Maintain clear communication so that client commitments, appointment requirements, and job information are understood across the team.

Follow up daily with clients who have requested communication. Resolve service concerns promptly, respectfully, and with empathy; provide daily updates to the Sales Manager on escalated interactions and support a quality or recommendation score of at least 9/10 through PulseM or an equivalent system.

Report directly to the Sales Manager, meet weekly to review goals and results, and attend meetings and required training prepared and on time. Participate in phone skills training at least twice yearly and help improve scripts and processes.

Maintain organized records and work areas, meet reporting deadlines, and promptly notify management of serious accidents, damage, liability or warranty concerns, fraud, theft, or serious Core Value breaches.

**QUALIFICATIONS FOR A SERVICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**

Prior experience in service coordination, dispatch, appointment scheduling, client care, or administrative operations. Experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, or another trade service business is strongly preferred.

Comfort managing a high volume of phone calls while completing time-sensitive scheduling, dispatch, and administrative responsibilities.

Fast, accurate keyboarding and the ability to listen, ask questions, and type directly into a CRM during a live conversation without first taking handwritten notes. Strong typing speed must be matched by accuracy and complete records.

Sound judgment and confidence making timely decisions within established procedures, with the ability to recognize when management input is needed.

Proven ability to work independently, take initiative, anticipate needs, and follow responsibilities through to completion without repeated reminders.

Strong attention to detail and a commitment to checking names, addresses, appointment times, payments, and job documentation for accuracy.

Ability to shift quickly between tasks, manage interruptions, and maintain a productive pace in a busy environment with changing priorities and firm deadlines.

Practical, analytical problem-solving skills and an understanding of how booking, scheduling, dispatch, and follow-up affect productivity, revenue, and profitability.

Clear verbal and written communication, professional phone skills, and the ability to explain service options and respond to objections while treating clients respectfully.

Confidence using CRM systems, scheduling tools, email, spreadsheets, and multiple computer applications, with the ability to learn new systems and follow established workflows.

Integrity, discretion with confidential information, dependable attendance, a positive work ethic, and a willingness to accept coaching and improve performance.

**SERVICE AREAS**

This is a full-time onsite position at our company offices in Oley, PA, supporting clients and field operations throughout Berks County and surrounding areas, including Reading and Allentown, PA.

**ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM**

Do you enjoy taking ownership of a busy schedule, solving practical problems, and keeping details accurate while the phones are ringing? Are you ready to combine excellent client care with the initiative and judgment that help a service business succeed? If our mission, Core Values, and expectations resonate with you, complete our quick, mobile-friendly application today. All applications are confidential. We look forward to meeting you!

**Mission:**

To Honor God by serving others around us with excellence

**Core Values: W.I.S.E.**

Core Values form the foundation of the company. Adhering to our Core Values will help us build a strong and healthy organization.

#1 Work Hard -We approach each task with diligence and a positive attitude.

#2 With Integrity – We are honest with our clients, each other, and ourselves.

#3 Serving others – We treat others as more important than ourselves.

#4 with Excellence – We execute at a high level, striving to exceed expectations.

0abcc03671a0eecd03f1.title: Pay Admin Specialist
0abcc03671a0eecd03f1.description:
OneSource Virtual (OSV) has worked exclusively with Workday customers since 2008 to deliver compliant, in-tenant technology and expert services to automate the administrative, transactional tasks of payroll, taxes, earned wage access, accounts payable, and benefits. With over 1,500 customers, 92% retention, and $225+ billion in treasury movement annually, OSV helps organizations maximize their Workday investment and operate it with confidence. Payroll, benefits, and finance solutions — all in one place.

**Summary**

The Pay Administration Specialist is responsible for providing payroll administration services and customer support to a defined book of OneSource Virtual customers. This role manages daily case work, responds to Workday and payroll questions, troubleshoots quarter-end and year-end audits, and partners with customers on quarterly business discussions.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as named Specialist for assigned Pay Administration customers, manage and respond to customer cases within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Assist customers with payroll-related questions and aid with Workday functionality questions in alignment with OSV Standard Operating Procedures
* Troubleshoot quarter-end and year-end audit reports and provide recommendations to customers
* Lead quarterly customer touchpoints and operational discussions, providing service overviews, status updates, and improvement recommendations
* Collaborate with peers and partner teams to resolve customer requests and stabilize service delivery
* Identify workflow and process improvements, contribute ideas, and participate in continuous improvement initiatives
* Maintain customer notes and known issue logs to support consistent service delivery across the team
* Meet quality and production targets across case management and customer-facing activities

**Competencies**

* Critical Thinking and Consultative Approach: Analyzes customer issues thoughtfully, weighs trade-offs, and recommends practical solutions that account for customer-specific context.
* Analytical and Research Skills: Researches payroll, and Workday issues, analyzes data, and applies findings to recommendations and resolutions.
* Customer Service: Maintains a professional, service-oriented approach across daily customer interactions and scheduled customer touchpoints, communicating clearly in writing, on the phone, and in customer-facing meetings.
* Workload and Priority Management: Manages multiple customers and competing deadlines effectively, with the ability to triage and re-prioritize as conditions shift.
* Payroll Knowledge: Demonstrates working knowledge of payroll fundamentals, processes, and compliance requirements; applies this knowledge to customer support.
* Compliance Awareness: Understands federal, state, and local payroll tax requirements, year-end and W-2 compliance considerations, and applies that knowledge in customer guidance and audit troubleshooting.
* Technical Aptitude: Learns Workday and supporting systems quickly and contributes to the effective use of automation and standard tools
* Process Orientation: Follows established procedures consistently, identifies opportunities for improvement, and escalates systemic issues with appropriate context.
* Adaptability: Adjusts effectively to new processes, system updates/changes, and workload shifts.
* Teamwork: Collaborates with peers and partner teams, supports collective goals, and assists colleagues during peak periods.

**Qualifications**

**Education/Certification** **Requirement**

* High School diploma or equivalent

**Required**

* 3+ years of payroll experience, including research, troubleshooting, and employee/customer support
* Experience with federal, state, and local payroll taxes
* Experience with quarter-end and year-end payroll processes, including W-2 activities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

**Preferred**

  

* Experience with Workday Payroll
* Experience with Salesforce or similar case management tools
* Experience in an outsourcing or shared services environment
* FPC (Fundamental Payroll Certification)
* Associate's degree in Accounting, Business, or a related field

You are encouraged to learn and share ideas when you join the OneSource Virtual team. We reward innovative thinking, fresh perspectives, creative collaboration, and hard work. As an organization experiencing routine strategic growth, we are always on the lookout for intelligent, talented, and forward-thinking professionals to join our team. OSV employees enjoy a values-based culture, upward mobility, and professional development with opportunities of all kinds.

**About Orbridge:**

Orbridge, founded in 2008, is a rapidly expanding high-end tour operator that specializes in educational tours for small groups in unique destinations. We prioritize excellent customer service and quality travel experience. Our primary client base includes alumni organizations from universities across the country, and we are expanding into new markets as we grow. The company office is in Poulsbo, WA.

The Sales & Partner Relations Coordinator supports Orbridge's Sales and Partner Relations teams by coordinating administrative, operational, and partner service activities. This role serves as a key liaison between Orbridge sales team members, alumni associations, affinity partners, and internal departments, helping ensure partners receive timely communication, accurate information, and exceptional support throughout the partnership lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is an organized and resourceful professional who excels at coordination, communication, and relationship management. They are detail-oriented, collaborative, and committed to providing exceptional service while supporting partner success, sales initiatives, and operational excellence.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Sales and Partner Support**

* Serve as an administrative resource for the Sales and Partner Relations team, supporting both internal projects and partner-facing activities.

* Enter and maintain customer, partner, and prospect information within CRM systems.
* Ensure accuracy of sales records, partner data, and account information.
* Maintain organized electronic files, contracts, and program records.

**Operational Support**

* Collaborate with Office Operations, Guest Services, Marketing, Operations, and Finance teams to support internal operational needs.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of administrative processes that improve team efficiency and partner service.

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Canva.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and handle multiple projects simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional experience in travel, tourism, hospitality, or events industries preferred.
* Knowledge of group, affinity, or educational travel programs.
* Experience supporting sales and partner relations functions in a customer-focused environment.

Join our dynamic dental team as a Dental Receptionist and Assistant, where your energy and dedication will help create a welcoming environment for patients and support the smooth operation of our clinic. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for patients, managing appointments, patient records, and administrative tasks while assisting dental professionals with clinical support. * Greet patients warmly, verify their information, and schedule appointments efficiently using dental practice management software.
* Manage patient check-in and check-out processes, ensuring accurate documentation and billing procedures.
* Handle incoming phone calls with professionalism, providing information and scheduling assistance while maintaining phone etiquette.

* Assist dental staff with clinical tasks including sterilization procedures, preparing treatment rooms, and passing instruments during procedures.

* Proficiency in EMR/EHR systems such as Epic, Meditech, Athenahealth, or eClinicalWorks; familiarity with electronic health records management is essential.
* Solid understanding of HIPAA compliance, medical billing procedures, CPT coding, ICD coding (ICD-9/10), Medicare processes, and care plan documentation.
* Exceptional customer service skills combined with professional phone etiquette and effective communication abilities.
* Bilingual capabilities are highly desirable to serve diverse patient populations effectively.

Join us to be part of a vibrant team dedicated to delivering outstanding patient care while supporting the operational excellence of our clinic!

490e235982357ff07a14.title: Patient Access Specialist - REMOTE
490e235982357ff07a14.description:
### **Patient Access Representative**

**GetixHealth | $16.00 per Hour + Quarterly Bonus Opportunities**

Are you passionate about helping patients navigate their healthcare experience? Do you have strong customer service skills, attention to detail, and experience working with insurance information or patient registration?

**GetixHealth is seeking dependable, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Patient Access Representatives to join our growing team!**

In this role, you will serve as an important point of contact for patients, helping ensure a smooth and accurate registration and scheduling experience. You will assist with insurance verification, patient scheduling, pre-registration, authorizations, and financial responsibilities while delivering exceptional customer service.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced healthcare environment and making a positive difference in the patient experience.

#### **Position Details:**

* **Position:** Patient Access Representative
* **Pay Rate:** $16.00 per hour
* **Bonus Opportunities:** Eligible for quarterly performance-based bonuses
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, with additional scheduling requirements outlined below
* **Remote Position:** Must pass the internet speed test
* **Equipment**: we provide the equipment

#### **Work Schedule & Availability Requirements:**

Candidates must be available to work the following schedule:

* **Regular Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Central Time
* **Late Shift:** One day per week, 10:30 AM–7:00 PM Central Time (in place of the regular shift)
* **Saturday Requirement:** One Saturday per month, 11:00 AM–4:00 PM Central Time

**IMPORTANT:** Flexibility is required. Candidates must be able to work the regular schedule, weekly late shift, and required monthly Saturday. Work schedules are subject to change based on business and operational needs.

#### 

#### **What You'll Do:**

As a Patient Access Representative, you will help patients navigate the registration process while ensuring accurate information is collected and documented.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Patient Registration & Insurance Verification**

* Accurately collect, review, and update patient demographic, insurance, and financial information.
* Verify insurance coverage, eligibility, benefits, co-pays, and deductibles.
* Ensure all required pre-registration information is complete before scheduled services.
* Identify missing or inaccurate information and take appropriate steps to resolve discrepancies.

**Appointment Scheduling & Coordination**

* Schedule patient appointments and clinical services accurately and efficiently.
* Confirm appointment availability, patient information, and insurance requirements.
* Coordinate with physician offices, clinical departments, and other healthcare teams to support timely scheduling.
* Assist with appointment-related questions and scheduling concerns.

**Insurance Authorizations & Documentation**

* Obtain and document required insurance pre-certifications, referrals, and prior authorizations.
* Communicate with insurance carriers and physician offices to resolve authorization or coverage issues.
* Accurately document insurance verification results, authorization numbers, and related information.
* Maintain complete and accurate records within designated healthcare systems.

**Patient Customer Service & Financial Support**

* Deliver professional, courteous, and compassionate customer service during patient interactions.
* Explain insurance benefits, co-pays, deductibles, and estimated patient financial responsibilities.
* Assist patients with questions regarding registration, scheduling, and payment requirements.
* Address patient concerns professionally and escalate complex issues when appropriate.

**Data Entry, Accuracy & Compliance**

* Enter and maintain accurate patient information in designated healthcare systems.
* Review and document applicable diagnosis and procedure codes when required.
* Maintain confidentiality of Protected Health Information (PHI).
* Follow HIPAA regulations, organizational policies, and established procedures.
* Meet departmental productivity, accuracy, quality, and customer service expectations.

  

#### **What We're Looking For:**

##### **Required Qualifications:**

Candidates must meet the following requirements:

* High school diploma or GED.
* **Minimum of 1 year of experience** in patient access, healthcare customer service, patient financial services, medical registration, or a related healthcare environment.
* **Ability to type at least 35 words per minute (WPM).**
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent customer service skills with a patient-focused approach.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy when entering patient and insurance information.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Basic computer proficiency and ability to navigate multiple systems.
* Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA requirements.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a team.
* Ability to work the required schedule, including one late shift per week and one Saturday per month.

##### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2–3 years of experience in patient access, patient registration, or healthcare revenue cycle operations.
* Associate or bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Finance, or a related field.
* Experience verifying medical insurance coverage, benefits, and eligibility.
* Familiarity with medical terminology, insurance authorization processes, and healthcare billing requirements.
* Experience working with electronic health records (EHR), patient registration systems, or hospital scheduling platforms.
* Previous experience in a high-volume healthcare call center or patient-facing environment.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is a plus.

##### **Typing Assessment Requirement:**

*All candidates must demonstrate a minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute (WPM).*

A typing assessment will be administered during the interview process. Candidates must meet the minimum typing requirement to be considered for the position.

  

**About GetixHealth:**

Founded in 1992, GetixHealth has grown into a leading provider of healthcare revenue cycle management services, with offices across the United States and India. We work with healthcare organizations to optimize their financial performance, offering solutions that enhance efficiency and profitability. Our team of 1,800 dedicated professionals delivers exceptional patient care, compliance, and cutting-edge technology to help clients succeed. **Location: Spring House, PA**

**What we’re looking for**

**Education:**

* High school diploma or GED required

**Experience:**

* Experience handling, processing, or coordinating biological, chemical, or research samples in a laboratory, research, or regulated environment.
* Knowledge of laboratory safety practices and applicable regulations related to the handling and transport of biological materials.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain records, documentation, and shipment information.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Competencies**

* Attention to Detail
* Compliance & Quality Focus
* Organization & Prioritization
* Communication Skills
* Problem Solving
* Customer Focus
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Accountability & Reliability

**How you will thrive and create an impact**

Avantor’s Advanced Laboratory Services team is a crucial part of the Avantor Services group serving over 500 customers in biopharma, pharmaceutical, educational, industrial, and high-tech industries with customizable, flexible solutions and end-to-end laboratory operations support. In this role you will:

* Responsible for outbound shipments (international & domestic) which include but are not limited to samples, biologics, cell lines, human and non-human materials.
* Responsibility for incoming shipments may be added as the program expands or utilized as needed.
* Receive and process shipments to deliver to designated department freezer for storage and pickup by researcher.
* Complete all necessary CLASP, LSA/Trade Compliance paperwork and documentation.
* Retrieve samples from designated department freezer, or location, after receiving intake files.
* Process samples and correctly classify samples via customer systems.

* Deliver samples under proper conditions to shipping office.
* Sign shipping documents and invoices as consigner.

The International Operations team serves as the primary point of contact for International Representatives who recruit for all of CIEE’s inbound work and professional exchange programs (BridgeUSA Summer Work Travel, Camp Counselor, Intern, and Trainee). * Support sales and operational efforts for Exchange programs by working closely with teammates and International Representatives.

* Review high volume of data for accuracy.
* Review annual compliance documents for accuracy.
* Review integrity and completeness of participant data.
* Update system data for participant and program contacts.

**What you’ll bring:**

* A minimum of one year of customer service and administrative experience.
* Post-secondary degree.
* Very strong attention to detail (in reviewing both data and written documents).
* Ability to take initiative and maintain flexibility with job duties.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word.
* Comfortable learning new technology.
* Team-oriented approach and ability to see the big picture.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to maintain professional demeanor in a busy environment and within tight deadlines.
* Energetic with a strong work ethic.
* International work or study abroad experience strongly preferred.
* Ability to work across cultures.
* Commitment to CIEE’s core values and mission

4c749ddb21b5e38d02af.title: Manager, Outbound Sales
4c749ddb21b5e38d02af.description:
**Manager, Outbound Sales**

*The Healthy Back Institute | Remote (Texas) | Full-Time, Exempt | People Leader*

**$77,000 to $87,000 base + variable, uncapped · Reports to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success · Outbound business development experience required**

**About Us**

Since 2003, the Healthy Back Institute has helped millions of people reclaim their freedom from pain. We are a remote, direct-to-consumer health and wellness company built on six core values: Freedom, Love, Team, Growth, Excellence, and Courage.

Our Sales team is central to the company's growth plan. We are seeking an experienced sales leader with a business development mindset to strengthen its operating foundation, expand books of business, programs, and reactivation, and support the launch of a wholesale channel in 2027.

**The Role**

The Manager, Outbound Sales carries the revenue target for a fully remote team of Value-Added Sales representatives who contact existing customers by phone and text to recommend the products, programs, and packages best suited to their needs. This role owns the pipeline, margin, coaching, offer strategy, and commission plan, and is accountable for building and developing the team that delivers results.

This is a hands-on leadership position within a lean organization. The Manager engages directly with the team, the dialer, and performance reporting each day and has the authority to set schedules, shape offers, and hold the team accountable to its targets. Initial priorities are operational: queue coverage, abandon rate, and consistent production from every representative. Beyond that foundation, the role is accountable for measurable revenue growth driven by business development: reactivating customers, launching programs, and building long-term customer relationships.

**What You'll Own**

***Revenue and Reporting***

* Monthly sales, gross profit, and net revenue targets for the team, managed against the company margin floor
* A concise, reliable weekly performance and forecast view for leadership, sourced from UltraCart today and from HubSpot and Aircall as those platforms are adopted
* Commission plan administration, including accurate and timely payouts and clear communication of results to the team

***Operating Foundation***

* Reduce abandon rate, stabilize queue coverage, and bring every representative to a consistent, fully ramped level of production
* Shift structure, coverage, and schedule adherence across outbound and inbound sales queues
* Team compliance: approved claims language, do-not-call handling, required disclosures, and call recording practices

***Growth***

* Expansion of books of business through outbound outreach, reactivation, and program offers, with guardrails that keep refund and chargeback rates within policy
* A shared customer-contact standard developed with Marketing to prevent over-contact across phone, SMS, and email
* Outbound program management: lead lists and segmentation, dialer campaigns, call cadences, and SMS follow-up, in partnership with Marketing and Lifecycle
* Development and maintenance of the offer playbook, call scripts, objection-handling guides, and reference materials

***Team Leadership***

* Daily management of team KPIs, including dials, contacts, talk time, conversion, revenue per call, average order value, gross profit per call, program and subscription adoption, coupon usage, and refunds
* Coaching through daily live and recorded call review, escalation and closing support, documented coaching logs, and weekly one-on-ones with every representative
* A structured remote team cadence of daily huddles, Slack communication, weekly team meetings, and recognition that keeps a distributed team engaged and accountable
* Recruiting, onboarding, and ramp of new representatives, including a Coordinator feeder and rehire pipeline; performance management and corrective action as needed

### **Requirements**

**What You Bring**

***Required***

* **Business development.** Five or more years in outbound phone sales or business development, with a documented record of owning a revenue target and growing it through prospecting, outbound campaigns, and long-term relationship building. A proven business development track record carries more weight than a sales management title.
* **D2C sales experience.** Direct-to-consumer outbound sales experience by phone in a DTC, direct-response, or subscription business, with a working understanding of how conversion drives average order value, lifetime value, and margin.
* **B2B sales experience.** Outbound phone sales experience selling to businesses, such as B2B SaaS, wholesale, distribution, or retail accounts. This role will support the development of a wholesale channel in 2027.
* **People leadership.** Substantial hands-on experience directly managing and developing a team of sales representatives, including hiring, ramping, and building a feeder or rehire pipeline.
* **Margin management.** Experience managing to gross profit per call, contribution margin, and refund and chargeback rates, not solely top-line revenue.
* **Coaching.** Demonstrated ability to coach through call observation and direct feedback, sell consultatively, communicate performance expectations clearly, and develop representatives accordingly.
* **Integrity.** A record of leading teams that achieve targets through ethical, consultative selling, and the judgment to identify and address sales conduct that does not meet company standards.
* **Systems and tools.** Hands-on proficiency with dialer and telephony platforms, call recording and quality assurance tools, SMS outreach, and CRM or contact-center systems, along with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for building scorecards and forecasts.
* **Commission plans.** Experience administering sales commission plans and managing pay cycles accurately.
* **Compliance.** Working knowledge of TCPA and telemarketing regulations, do-not-call compliance, and FTC and DSHEA guidance governing dietary supplement claims.

***Preferred***

* Health, wellness, or dietary supplement industry experience
* Outbound sales experience in home services, consumer packaged goods, food distribution or food service supply, or short-term rental property management
* Subscription, free trial, or continuity business model experience
* Experience designing sales commission plans
* HubSpot, Aircall, or UltraCart experience
* Bachelor's degree in business or a related field

### **Benefits**

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary $77,000 to $87,000, plus an uncapped, performance-based variable incentive plan tied to team revenue and margin results. Remote with a flexible schedule and genuine work/life balance. Medical, dental, and vision insurance. 401(k) with a 3.5% match. Life and disability insurance. Flexible PTO. Discounts on HBI products.

*If you have grown revenue through outbound business development, led the team behind it, and want to be paid on how much it grows, we would love to hear from you.*

f964a76195244088847b.title: Content Management and Operations Lead (Drupal)
f964a76195244088847b.description:
**Content Management and Operations Lead (Drupal)**
===================================================

**Job Number: 984**  
  
**This is a remote position.**

Ad Hoc is a technology company that empowers organizations to deliver scalable, impactful digital services. Using modern, agile methods, our team creates products that meet people’s needs and transform their experience of government.

**Work on things that matter**

Our collaborations have shaped some of the defining moments in public-sector service delivery. We’ve helped build products that connect Veterans to tailored services, help millions access affordable health care, and support important programs like Head Start. As we work with agencies to deliver critical services, we’re also changing how the government approaches technology.

**Built for a remote life**

Our culture, communications, and tools are built for remote work, enabling us to bring together top talent nationwide. At Ad Hoc, remote life empowers our teams to design work environments that fit their lives and that foster flexibility and collaboration to achieve positive outcomes for our customers.

**Committed to high expectations and a welcoming culture**

Ad Hoc values acceptance, accountability, and humility. We aren’t heroes. We learn from our mistakes and improve the process for the next time. We build small, inclusive teams to collaborate closely with our partners to solve the right problems and deliver software that works.

The **Federal Civilian** business unit supports many customers spanning the federal, commercial, and nonprofit space. Our customers include NASA, the General Services Administration, Office of Personnel Management, the Library of Congress, Health & Human Services, and the FDIC. We partner with these agencies to build new capabilities, deliver products, establish data as a strategic asset for informed decision-making, modernize legacy systems, and build the digital service infrastructure necessary to scale their mission impact.

**Role Overview**

Ad Hoc is seeking a Content Management and Operations Lead (Drupal) to lead content operations supporting a federal financial regulatory web services program. This position is responsible for the day-to-day management of the content operations team, including staff supervision, workload prioritization, quality assurance, performance management, and operational delivery.

The customer's mission depends on timely, accurate, and accessible communication with audiences ranging from individual consumers to financial institutions and investors. Publishing time-sensitive regulatory information requires exceptional attention to detail, strong operational discipline, and a commitment to accuracy.

In this hands-on leadership role, you will directly supervise the team responsible for developing, reviewing, publishing, and maintaining web content in Drupal. You will establish operational priorities, manage team performance, and implement the standards, workflows, and governance practices necessary to ensure the customer's digital content is accurate, accessible, secure, and delivered on time.

You will serve as a key operational leader and subject matter expert in Drupal content administration, editorial workflows, information architecture, and publishing operations. Working directly with the customer's Web Team and content coordinators across multiple divisions, you will provide leadership and guidance on content structure, accessibility, usability, and Drupal authoring best practices.

You will also oversee content operations supporting major website initiatives, including feature launches, awareness campaigns, redesigns, and content modernization efforts. This position requires someone who can balance people leadership, strategic planning, and hands-on technical expertise while maintaining accountability for service delivery in a deadline-driven federal environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Primary expectations of a Content Management and Operations Lead include:**

* Directly manage and supervise a team of content specialists, including assigning work, establishing priorities, providing coaching and performance feedback, conducting performance evaluations, and supporting professional development.
* Oversee daily content management operations, including intake, prioritization, workload distribution, quality assurance, and publication of content requests across the public website and intranet, ensuring established service-level agreements (SLAs) are met.
* Manage staffing capacity, resource allocation, workload distribution, and operational coverage to ensure the team meets customer requirements and program commitments.
* Establish clear performance expectations, monitor team productivity and quality metrics, identify performance gaps, and implement improvements to strengthen operational effectiveness.
* Serve as the program's Drupal content management subject matter expert, providing technical leadership and oversight of content types, fields, taxonomies, media libraries, menus, navigation, layouts, editorial workflows, moderation states, and user permissions.
* Oversee website content maintenance and administration, including redirects, metadata, menus, and page layouts within Drupal, providing hands-on support for complex or high-priority requests and coordinating with development teams when custom functionality is required.
* Develop, document, implement, and enforce content governance standards, publishing procedures, editorial workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure published content and templates comply with Section 508 and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.x standards, overseeing accessibility testing, issue resolution, and remediation activities.
* Lead and coordinate training for government stakeholders and content coordinators on Drupal authoring, information architecture, page layouts, content organization, usability, accessibility, and publishing best practices.
* Manage content planning and operational delivery for major initiatives, including website redesigns, feature launches, content migrations, and high-visibility communications campaigns.
* Partner with design, development, and program leadership to establish content requirements, improve content models, and support enhancements to website functionality and user experience.
* Oversee content-related site search functionality, including metadata, taxonomy, search configuration, and optimization to improve content discoverability.
* Leverage web analytics and operational performance metrics to evaluate content effectiveness, monitor service delivery, identify trends, and drive improvements to content organization, accessibility, and user experience.
* Direct and coordinate confidential and time-sensitive publishing activities, including regulatory announcements and bank closing events, ensuring strict adherence to customer security requirements, release procedures, and quality standards.
* Collaborate with development, DevSecOps, design, quality assurance, and third-party teams to coordinate releases, incidents, upgrades, and other activities affecting content operations.
* Maintain oversight of team assignments, deliverables, and operational documentation using Jira, Confluence, or equivalent customer-approved tools, contributing to weekly status reports, monthly SLA reporting, and quarterly performance reviews.
* Lead operational planning, participate in Agile ceremonies, and coordinate cross-functional activities to support efficient and predictable content delivery.
* Identify and address operational risks, resource constraints, quality concerns, and workflow inefficiencies, escalating issues to program leadership as appropriate.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen publishing efficiency, content governance, team effectiveness, and the overall quality of the customer's digital presence.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in web content operations or content management for large, public-facing websites, including demonstrated experience directly supervising employees or managing content publishing teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing team performance, assigning and prioritizing work, coordinating staffing resources, providing employee feedback, and maintaining accountability for operational delivery.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience administering or building content within Drupal 9, 10, or 11, including content types, fields, taxonomies, Views, media management, menus, Layout Builder or Paragraphs, content moderation, editorial workflows, and user roles and permissions.
* Strong working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with working familiarity with JavaScript sufficient to troubleshoot rendered content and template-related issues.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining Section 508 and WCAG accessibility standards, including hands-on testing using assistive technologies such as NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver.
* Experience developing, implementing, and enforcing content standards, editorial workflows, publishing procedures, and SOPs.
* Experience managing content operations against established SLAs, including accountability for measurable accuracy, response time, resolution, and quality expectations.
* Experience using web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4) or equivalent tools, along with site search configuration and optimization.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments using Jira, Confluence, or equivalent project management and collaboration tools.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, resolve operational challenges, and maintain team accountability in a deadline-driven environment.
* Excellent written, verbal, leadership, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to advise nontechnical stakeholders, provide training, and establish clear operational standards.
* Ability to obtain and maintain the required federal background investigation and Public Trust suitability determination.
* Must meet applicable contractual citizenship or lawful permanent residency requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing content operations teams supporting large-scale Drupal website redesigns, modernization, or replatforming initiatives, including content audits, inventory management, content modeling, template mapping, restructuring, migration, and post-launch support.
* Acquia Certified Drupal Site Builder certification or equivalent Drupal certification.
* Experience supporting federal government websites, particularly within financial regulatory agencies.
* Familiarity with the 21st Century Integrated Digital Experience Act (IDEA), OMB Memorandum M-23-22, and the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS).
* Experience administering Drupal within a FedRAMP-authorized hosting environment, such as an appropriately authorized Acquia, Pantheon, or Cloud.gov environment.
* Familiarity with Git-based Drupal configuration management, including configuration export/import processes and CI/CD release workflows.
* Experience with structured content, content strategy, information architecture, and federal plain-language standards.
* Experience managing digital assets and overseeing PDF accessibility remediation using Adobe Acrobat or equivalent tools.
* Experience managing confidential, embargoed, or time-sensitive publishing events requiring strict quality controls and coordinated release procedures.
* Experience overseeing operational performance reporting, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives within a federal government contract environment.

**To learn more about working at Ad Hoc, please visit:** https://adhocteam.us/join

**Benefits:**

* Company-subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible PTO
* 401K with employer match
* Paid parental leave after one year of service
* Employee Assistance Program

Ad Hoc LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, pregnancy, disability, work-related injury, covered veteran status, political ideology, marital status, or any other factor that the law protects from employment discrimination.

We value the unique skills gained through military service and encourage veterans and transitioning service members to apply.

In support of various state and city equal pay transparency laws, Ad Hoc job descriptions feature the starting range we reasonably expect to pay to candidates who would join our team with little to no need for training on the responsibilities we've outlined above. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and responsibility. The range of starting pay for this role is $110,000-$155,000, with ultimate salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. Our recruiters will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements.
