77846468ab2b8acc9d11.title: Senior Director, Member Engagement Operations
77846468ab2b8acc9d11.description:
Senior Director, Member Engagement Operations (Remote)

**About Us:**

Matrix Medical Network is the nation’s leading independent provider of comprehensive in-home health assessments, serving Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid and Commercial patients across all 50 states. With a network of 3,000 + clinicians, we deliver personalized Whole Person Care that includes diagnostic testing, risk identification, medication management and preventive health education, empowering people to better manage acute and chronic conditions. Guided by our mantra- *We see you. We hear you. We’ve got you.*- and our core values of Integrity, Accountability, Trust, Respect and Passion, we are committed to creating a culture where both patients and teammates feel valued, supported and heard.

**Why Work at Matrix?**

  

* The opportunity to work with one of the fastest growing companies in healthcare whose vision is to provide unparalleled quality and value to providers and members.
* A chance to work with great people on exciting projects.
* Our opportunities allow you to leverage your expertise and compassion, making a direct impact to the health and well-being of members.
* Competitive Compensation: Be rewarded for your effort and passion while making a difference in the community.

**About the role:**

**Type:** Full Time, Salary

**Compensation:** $134,000-$202,000/yr., 20-30% Bonus

**Location:** Fully Remote, must be in the United States

**Hours:** Full Time Days

**Benefits Offered to include:** Medical, Dental, Vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K with company matching, voluntary life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, additional voluntary benefits available.

**What to Expect:**

The Sr. Director, Member Engagement Operations is responsible for leading the operational execution of Matrix Medical Network's omnichannel member engagement strategy, ensuring a seamless, consistent, and effective experience across all member interaction channels. This role provides strategic operational leadership and accountability for contact center operations, business process outsourcing (BPO) partnerships, member engagement technologies, and performance optimization.

The Sr. Director oversees the integration and execution of member engagement activities across voice, text, chat, digital self-service, and scheduling channels, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve member access, engagement, conversion, and operational efficiency. This leader is accountable for vendor performance, quality outcomes, and the successful implementation of an evolving, technology-enabled engagement model.

Working collaboratively with Marketing, Product & Technology, Enterprise Demand & Planning, and Clinical/Compliance leadership, this position translates enterprise strategies into scalable operational processes that support business objectives, improve the member experience, and drive measurable performance results.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Member Engagement Operations & Omnichannel Execution**

* Lead the operational execution of Matrix's member engagement model across multiple communication channels, including inbound and outbound calls, two-way text messaging, chat, digital self-service, and scheduling.
* Ensure consistent, coordinated member interactions throughout the engagement lifecycle, from initial outreach and appointment scheduling through visit confirmation and completion.
* Develop and implement scalable operational processes that improve member accessibility, responsiveness, engagement, and conversion.
* Oversee the integration of engagement channels to create a seamless member experience while optimizing operational performance and resource utilization.
* Partner with Enterprise Demand & Planning to align workforce deployment, channel utilization, and operational activities with business demand and engagement priorities.
* Identify and implement opportunities to enhance member engagement through alternative channels, strategic partnerships, and innovative outreach approaches.

**Contact Center & Vendor Management**

* Provide leadership and operational oversight of outsourced contact center and BPO partners, ensuring alignment with established service expectations, contractual commitments, and performance standards.
* Lead operational planning, onboarding, transitions, and performance stabilization for BPO partnerships to ensure service continuity and business readiness.
* Establish vendor governance, performance scorecards, service-level expectations, and accountability measures to drive consistent operational results.
* Monitor vendor and agent-level productivity, quality, efficiency, and member engagement outcomes, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as needed.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to evaluate vendor capabilities, identify operational risks, and recommend improvements to the overall service delivery model.
* Ensure consistent operational processes, quality standards, and member experiences across internal and outsourced engagement activities.

**Technology, Automation & AI-Enabled Engagement**

* Lead the operational implementation and adoption of technology-enabled engagement solutions, including automation, predictive analytics, and agentic AI capabilities across voice, text, and chat channels.
* Partner with Product & Technology to optimize contact center platforms, member engagement systems, and digital scheduling capabilities.
* Establish operational processes and performance standards for AI-enabled tools, including automated quality assurance, interaction documentation, call dispositions, and real-time agent guidance.
* Leverage engagement analytics, propensity models, and next-best-action capabilities to improve outreach effectiveness, channel selection, and member conversion.
* Oversee the operational utilization and optimization of enterprise engagement platforms, including Care Compass and Genesys.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and operational capabilities that improve member engagement, productivity, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Ensure appropriate operational controls, quality monitoring, and compliance considerations are incorporated into technology-enabled engagement processes.

**Performance Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and monitor key performance indicators to evaluate member engagement effectiveness, operational efficiency, vendor performance, and overall service quality.
* Drive performance improvement initiatives focused on contact rates, acceptance rates, conversion rates, cost per completed assessment, and member experience outcomes.
* Utilize operational data, reporting, and analytics to identify performance trends, service gaps, and opportunities to improve engagement strategies and processes.
* Develop and implement quality assurance frameworks that evaluate both individual agent/vendor performance and the end-to-end member engagement experience.
* Ensure scheduling, reminders, confirmations, and visit completion processes are accurate, coordinated, and effective across applicable visit types.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to streamline workflows, reduce operational costs, improve productivity, and enhance member satisfaction.
* Provide regular performance updates, operational insights, and recommendations to executive leadership.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Strategic Execution**

* Collaborate with Marketing to operationalize member communication strategies, messaging, and content across engagement channels while maintaining clear functional accountability.
* Partner with Product & Technology to translate business requirements into practical, scalable technology solutions and operational workflows.
* Work closely with Clinical and Compliance leadership to ensure member engagement processes support clinical requirements, regulatory standards, and organizational policies.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Demand & Planning leadership to align workforce management execution, staffing priorities, and channel capacity with operational needs.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives supporting new engagement capabilities, vendor transitions, process improvements, and enterprise transformation efforts.
* Identify operational risks, dependencies, and opportunities, proactively developing solutions that support business continuity and strategic objectives.
* Serve as a key operational advisor to executive leadership on member engagement performance, capabilities, and improvement opportunities.

**Leadership & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability for assigned teams, vendor relationships, and operational initiatives.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operational priorities, and accountability measures to support high-performing teams and partners.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, innovation, and member-focused service delivery.
* Develop organizational capabilities to support evolving engagement technologies, operational models, and business requirements.
* Effectively lead through organizational change, balancing strategic priorities with timely execution and measurable results.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, or a related field required.
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related discipline preferred.
* Equivalent combinations of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations, contact center operations, member engagement, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale, multichannel contact center operations, including outsourced BPO partnerships.
* Proven experience managing vendor performance, operational transitions, and complex service delivery models.
* Experience within Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, managed care, value-based care, or related healthcare environments strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success implementing operational improvements, technology-enabled solutions, and performance optimization initiatives.
* Experience leveraging AI, automation, predictive analytics, or advanced engagement technologies in a production environment preferred.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and deliver measurable business results within aggressive timelines.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong understanding of healthcare member engagement, contact center operations, and omnichannel service delivery models.
* Expertise in outsourced vendor management, performance governance, quality assurance, and operational accountability.
* Working knowledge of contact center technologies, CRM platforms, digital engagement tools, and workforce management principles.
* Ability to translate strategic business objectives into actionable operational plans, processes, and performance expectations.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to interpret operational metrics and drive data-informed decisions.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled engagement technologies, automation capabilities, and emerging contact center innovations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex operational transformations and manage competing priorities in a dynamic business environment.
* Strong executive communication, relationship management, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to identify operational risks, develop solutions, and execute improvements while maintaining service continuity.
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities with a focus on accountability, team development, change management, and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of healthcare regulatory requirements, member privacy, and compliance considerations relevant to member engagement operations.

**Our Culture**:

* We have a clear vision of where we are going, and we are guided by core values that embody our organization and our culture.
* We emphasizes innovation and growth, and you will be given the opportunities and tools to develop personally and professionally.
* We encourage and celebrate collaboration.
* We have a deep commitment to positively impact the communities in which we work and to make a difference in the lives of who we serve.

Matrix Medical Network is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of Matrix to provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. It is also the policy of Matrix that qualified individuals with disabilities receive equal opportunity in regard to job application procedures, hiring, and all aspects of the employment process. * Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

* Business Professional - Non-Exempt

* Facilities and Administration

The Facilities Development Manager plans, coordinates, and executes capital projects across the firm’s real estate portfolio, including law firm office buildouts, renovations, infrastructure upgrades, and related facilities initiatives and projects. This role serves as a day-to-day point of contact for project coordination, budgets, timelines, issue escalation, and communication between internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with firm standards.

  
  

This position will also serve as a key contact for Office Services and Office Coordinators, providing operational structure and support across the firm’s nine offices.

  
  

While this position offers the flexibility of a hybrid work arrangement, it is essential to note that in-person presence is required as the job demands. The nature of the role necessitates regular on-site attendance to effectively fulfill the responsibilities and ensure seamless operations.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Project Planning & Execution:**

* Develop project scopes, budgets, and schedules for capital improvement initiatives.
* Conduct feasibility studies and risk assessments.
* Prepare and manage RFPs, bids, and contract negotiations.
* Support ongoing management of the firm’s real estate portfolio, including law firm office buildouts, relocations, renovations, and related facilities planning initiatives.

**Communication and Organization**

* Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Maintain detailed project documentation and ensure timely follow-up on all action items.
* Schedule and lead project meetings with internal teams/stakeholders and external vendors.
* Provide regular updates to the Director of Facilities on progress, challenges, and next steps.
* Expertise in scheduling, meeting coordination, note taking and follow-up processes.

**Timeline Adherence:**

* Monitor project milestones and proactively address delays to keep projects on schedule.
* Implement corrective actions when timelines are at risk.

**Budget Management & Reconciliation:**

* Manage project budgets, track expenditures, and reconcile costs against approved allocations.
* Prepare financial reports and ensure transparency in budget adjustments.
* Support annual budget planning and Capital Improvement Planning (CIPs) by identifying project needs, estimating costs, and aligning proposed investments with firm priorities.
* Report out to stakeholders on a regular basis.

**Construction & Vendor Management:**

* Oversee contractors, consultants, and vendors to ensure adherence to specifications and timelines.
* Monitor progress, when applicable present change order requests, and resolve issues promptly.

**Compliance & Quality Control:**

* Ensure compliance with building codes, ADA requirements, and safety regulations.
* Implement quality assurance processes throughout the project lifecycle.

**Collaboration & Communication:**

* Coordinate with internal teams, architects, engineers, vendors, and external partners.
* Maintain clear communication and provide updates to stakeholders.
* Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for facilities-related project coordination, responding to routine questions, escalating issues as needed, and ensuring timely communication between internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Support day-to-day facilities and administrative services operations, including invoice coordination, understanding site-specific needs, and serving as a point of contact for local Office Coordinators across firm locations.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s Degree. Minimum 5 years in facilities management or capital project management, with proven experience in large-scale renovations or construction projects. PMP and/or FMP certification a plus.

Must be comfortable with travel as needed for project oversight, vendor coordination, and site visits. Estimated travel requirement: **up to 30%** but must be flexible to project demands.

  

Stradley Ronon offers a competitive benefits package that includes medical, vision, dental, and prescription drug coverage; health savings account (with applicable medical plan); flexible spending accounts; life insurance; short- and long-term disability coverage; and 401(k). Additionally, the firm provides family forming and hormonal health benefits; childcare leave; backup child and adult care; pre-tax commuter benefits; an employee assistance program; a wellbeing program; vacation and other paid time off.

  
  

**No agencies please.** For questions regarding this position, please contact Julie Oates, Talent Acquisition Manager, at joates@stradley.com. Outside agencies, search firms and/or their representatives will not be compensated in any way for unsolicited candidate submissions, or submissions made through anyone other than a Legal Recruiting Department representative.

  
  

Stradley Ronon Stevens & Young, LLP is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

e249d5a01b95fe17f6db.description:
Job Description:

**Role title:** Manager, Data Migration

**Salary range:** $90,000 - $125,000 USD

**Location:** Remote - US - Chicago, Dallas, Atlanta

**The opportunity**

Applied is building the connective intelligence that moves insurance. Every function contributes to that work. In this role, you will lead a team of Data Migration Engineers who move customer data from competitor and legacy systems into Applied Systems SaaS products.

As a people leader within Data Services, the Manager sets priorities, adapts plans when resources or operations shift, and makes sure customers get high quality migration outcomes. You guide your team on technical work and partner with Onboarding and Success Services, Development, Operations, Solution Services, and Support to deliver complex, end-to-end projects.  
  
This role works hand in hand with a global Data Services team using a Follow the Sun delivery model. You will keep work moving across regions and time zones, hand off cleanly, and step in when a project needs extra attention. You work within established policies, procedures, and business plans, and you take direction from your senior leader. Success here takes steady judgment, clear communication, and a coaching mindset as tools, platforms, and processes keep evolving.

**What** **you’ll** **own**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Migration Engineers, including regular 1:1s, goal setting, performance reviews, and corrective action or performance improvement plans when needed
* Own the team’s performance and results, using project data, quality dashboards, and workload metrics to track progress and guide improvement
* Provide technical guidance to your team, colleagues, and customers on data migration approaches, including script review, scope review, and troubleshooting complex issues
* Adapt priorities and project plans when resources, timelines, or operational needs change, so the team works on what matters most
* Monitor projects daily and weekly, spot risks early, and step in on escalations and project fires across Slack, Jira, and email
* Review and approve script requests, development tickets, and post-activation scripts, following Data Services policies and procedures
* Support quality control by monitoring quality boards and dashboards, and by driving fixes when issues show up
* Monitor and manage team costs, including timesheets, additional compensation, and weekend coverage hours
* Recommend changes to Data Services policies, processes, and tooling, and keep documentation current as those changes roll out
* Partner with Development, Operations, and cloud and engineering teams to resolve defects, escalate infrastructure issues, and shape new or evolving solutions
* Work with fellow managers, supervisors, and functional peers to align schedules, resources, and handoffs across regions and time zones
* Explain complex technical information clearly to audiences who know the subject, and present project and program updates that build cooperation across teams
* Take part in the management rotation for weekend coverage, including monitoring live merges and go/no-go decisions
* Help advance department initiatives, including adopting cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery and intelligent tooling that improves migration speed, scalability, and quality

**What** **you’ll** **bring**

* Experience leading or mentoring technical teams, with a track record of coaching people, setting clear goals, and handling performance conversations with care
* Strong working knowledge of database structures and SQL, with enough depth to review scripts and guide engineers through complex migration, integration, or transformation work
* Solid understanding of ETL concepts, data mapping, and data quality best practices
* Hands-on experience with SaaS data migration or ETL initiatives in a production environment
* Ability to manage multiple competing project timelines and adjust plans quickly, while keeping customers and quality front and center
* Comfort leading in a collaborative, global environment where work moves across regions and time zones
* Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics, present to peers and stakeholders, and gain cooperation across teams and with customers during escalations
* Sound judgment and the ability to make decisions within established policies and business plans, while staying calm when priorities change
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline

**What could set you apart**

* Experience or exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery and Cloud Storage
* Experience introducing automation, scripting, or AI-assisted tools to improve data analysis, migration, or quality assurance
* Experience with insurance technology or agency management systems
* Experience using Jira, Confluence, Slack, or similar tools to track work, collaborate across teams, and document processes
* Experience with HR and workforce tools such as UKG for timekeeping and performance management

*Your background may bring strengths we have not listed here. If the role and its impact interest you, we encourage you to apply.*

**Build a career that moves an industry**

Applied is the connective intelligence transforming how insurance works. We build the platforms, data, and intelligent systems that connect agencies and carriers across the insurance lifecycle.

Here, careers move with the work. You can own meaningful decisions, build what reaches the market, expand your scope as the business evolves, and work alongside people who bring expertise, curiosity, and care to what they create.

**What you can expect**

* **Work with reach:** Build products, services, or programs that support agencies, carriers, and teammates across the insurance lifecycle.
* **Ownership with context:** Make decisions with a clear view of customer needs, business priorities, and the teammates who bring the work to market.
* **Growth through scope:** Expand your impact through meaningful projects, cross-functional exposure, learning opportunities, and stretch work as the business evolves.
* **Built by people:** Work with people who bring expertise, curiosity, and care to what they build, and who share accountability for moving the work forward.

9d919784fc44d0999d15.title: Project Director - Clinical Study Management
9d919784fc44d0999d15.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.  
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced clinical research professional to oversee the successful execution and delivery of clinical projects within an assigned region. This role serves as a key point of contact for sponsors, providing project oversight and ensuring clinical studies are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with quality and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with Clinical Project Managers (CPMs), cross-functional teams, and external vendors to support project planning, resource management, and operational performance. This position also contributes to business development initiatives, team development, and continuous process improvement to ensure consistent, high-quality project delivery.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Serve as the primary regional representative for clinical projects, ensuring successful execution and delivery in alignment with sponsor expectations, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Establish and maintain strong sponsor relationships, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of issues, and alignment on project expectations and deliverables.
* Oversee clinical project planning, implementation, and execution in collaboration with Clinical Project Managers and cross-functional teams.
* Review and approve project scope, budgets, timelines, performance metrics, resource requirements, and training plans to ensure successful project delivery.
* Monitor project progress, critical paths, risks, and performance indicators, providing guidance to Clinical Project Managers to address challenges and maintain project quality.
* Ensure clinical projects comply with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), regulatory requirements, corporate guidelines, and industry best practices.
* Oversee project forecasting, resource allocation, and staffing requirements to ensure appropriate support for current and upcoming clinical projects.
* Monitor internal team and third-party vendor performance, ensuring services consistently meet sponsor expectations and project requirements.
* Support team management activities, including recruitment, performance evaluations, employee training, development, and departmental budget planning.
* Contribute to business development activities, including proposal development, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), bid defenses, and prospective client engagement.

**Skills & Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Minimum of **7 years of relevant professional experience** in clinical research or a related field, supported by ongoing professional training and development.
* A three-year advanced college diploma or degree in a relevant discipline, preferably Health Sciences, Clinical Research, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of clinical project planning, execution, oversight, and delivery within established quality and regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain collaborative relationships with sponsors, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional project teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate project updates, risks, and expectations clearly and effectively.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to monitor multiple project priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* Ability to assess project requirements, identify potential risks, resolve issues, and support effective decision-making to achieve positive outcomes.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities, with the ability to foster teamwork, support employee development, and promote accountability.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a demonstrated commitment to delivering high-quality services and achieving project objectives.
* Commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and improving operational processes and team performance.

### **What We Offer**

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

* Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
* Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
* One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
* Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
* Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
* Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
* Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
* Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

*Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.*

### **Our Services**

* End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
* Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
* Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
* Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
* Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

### **How to Apply**

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

### **Equal Opportunity and Accessibility**

*Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

*Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to* *recruitment@alimentiv.com**.*

*Please note that the salary range may vary depending on the country in which the position is based.*

  

### **Performance-Based Incentive Program**

At Alimentiv, we recognize and reward great performance. In addition to a competitive salary, eligible employees can participate in our **Short-Term Incentive Plan (STIP)**, which offers the opportunity to earn additional compensation based on individual contributions, team achievements, and company performance.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Alimentiv is aware of the continued increase of phishing scams, leveraging various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media. Please note that Alimentiv only uses company email addresses, which contain “@alimentiv.com”, to communicate with candidates via email. If you are contacted by someone about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender’s email address and that they are asking you to apply on this website. If you believe you’ve been a victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report.

**Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams**

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

d0d91974fb660ceef79f.title: Market Operations Coordinator
d0d91974fb660ceef79f.description:
**Market Operations Coordinator**
=================================

**Patriot Growth Insurance Services | Remote | United States | Full-Time**

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

As a Market Operations Coordinator, you'll support the daily operations of Patriot's Mid-Atlantic 1 market by keeping administrative and financial processes accurate, organized, and on schedule. Your work across billing, commissions, payments, reconciliations, and office coordination will help agency teams maintain consistent workflows and dependable service.

Working closely with the Director, Market Operations, Finance, regional accounting partners, and agency teams, you'll complete assigned transactions, maintain supporting documentation, and research routine discrepancies. You'll follow established procedures and approval requirements, escalating exceptions and decisions that require management review.

**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* Coordinate operational projects, communications, and administrative activities assigned by the Director, Market Operations.
* Maintain procedures, tracking logs, records, and supporting documentation to promote accuracy and consistency across the market.
* Support Agency Management System administration through transaction processing, document management, reporting assistance, user-request coordination, and issue escalation.
* Prepare and distribute client invoices for agency-billed service fees, consulting fees, and other assigned charges using approved agreements, rates, schedules, and documentation.
* Maintain billing schedules and agreement records, confirming required approvals before releasing invoices.
* Process direct-bill activity, including carrier statement downloads, data entry, receipt matching, production recording, and reconciliation support.
* Prepare and distribute commission statements and support employee, producer, intercompany, broker, and 1099-related commission activity.
* Review accounts-receivable aging and unapplied transactions, document routine follow-up, and escalate delinquent or disputed balances for resolution.
* Generate client statements and installment invoices, and process approved client and finance-company refunds.
* Support surplus-lines filings for the cyber practice and Mid-Atlantic 1, along with compliance reporting such as unclaimed-property filings.
* Complete assigned month-end close activities, reconciliations, reporting schedules, and supporting documentation within regional accounting deadlines.
* Prepare schedules and documentation for journal entries and financial reports, researching routine variances and submitting materials for review and approval.
* Coordinate vendor invoice processing and prepare approved carrier, broker, premium, government, and vendor-payable transactions.
* Maintain payable subledger documentation and respond to routine billing, commission, and payment inquiries from vendors, carriers, and brokers.
* Maintain vendor records and contract tracking, coordinate renewal documentation, and escalate service or contract concerns to the Director, Market Operations.
* Support deposits, cash receipts, payment application, approved bank transfers, finance-company transactions, and ACH and electronic-funds-transfer activity.
* Complete assigned bank and transaction reconciliations, identifying missing documentation, recurring errors, reconciling items, and control concerns for escalation.
* Coordinate office service requests, maintenance, approved purchases, supplies, inventory, and employee operational onboarding needs across assigned locations.
* Support mail, check, document distribution, deposit, and secure records-handling workflows in accordance with established procedures.

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Detail-oriented and thorough, with a strong commitment to accurate records and complete documentation.
* Dependable and organized, with the ability to balance recurring deadlines and changing priorities.
* A practical problem-solver who researches discrepancies and follows issues through to resolution or appropriate escalation.
* A clear communicator who coordinates effectively with colleagues and external business partners.
* Collaborative and comfortable supporting multiple teams and office locations.
* Careful and accountable when following approval requirements and financial controls.
* Discreet and professional when handling confidential employee, client, banking, and financial information.

**What You Bring**
------------------

### **Day One:**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Experience supporting administrative, billing, accounting, bookkeeping, finance operations, or commission-processing activities involving financial transactions and reconciliations.
* Working knowledge of billing, receivables, payables, commissions, deposits, reconciliations, and month-end close support.
* Experience using Agency Management Systems, accounting systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office Suite, and other financial and operational processing tools.
* Ability to enter, reconcile, review, and report transactional and financial data accurately while maintaining complete supporting documentation.
* Ability to follow established accounting, revenue-recognition, documentation, approval, control, and escalation requirements.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize recurring responsibilities, meet deadlines, and coordinate with internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to research discrepancies, identify routine process issues, recommend practical improvements, and recognize when management review is needed.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to confidentiality, data accuracy, operational controls, and ethical conduct.

### **Valuable Additions:**

* Experience working at an insurance agency supporting Employee Benefits, Property and Casualty, or both.
* Experience with Applied Epic and accounting systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or QuickBooks.
* Experience with agency and consulting-fee billing, direct bill, carrier and broker payables, commission accounting, accounts-receivable aging, banking transactions, and month-end close support.
* Experience supporting an insurance brokerage with multiple offices or states, acquisition activity, or a matrixed organizational structure.
* Associate degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Real Benefits for Real Life**
-------------------------------

At Patriot, great benefits mean more than coverage; they mean being there through every stage of life: your health, your family, your financial future, or simply time to recharge. Whether you're working or not, life doesn't stop. Neither should your benefits.

**Highlights Include:**

* Multiple medical plan options, with preventive care covered at 100%
* Free virtual medical and mental healthcare for employees and their families, plus a dedicated healthcare concierge to help you navigate benefits, compare prescription costs, and make more confident, personalized care decisions
* Employer-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage
* Paid parental leave
* Personalized PTO that lets you take time away when you need it, without traditional accruals, plus separate sick leave
* Competitive 401(k) company match to help you build your financial future
* Comprehensive dental and vision coverage
* Employee Assistance Program with confidential mental health, legal, financial, and work-life support

**About Patriot Growth Insurance Services**
-------------------------------------------

At Patriot, we build our teams around a simple idea: people do their best work when they feel supported as whole people, not just managed as employees. We're invested in your growth, not just your output, and we back that up with a competitive salary and a comprehensive health and welfare program that extends to your family and domestic partners too, because who you're building a life with matters to us as much as the work you do.

Founded in 2019, Patriot is a growth-focused national insurance services firm that partners with employee benefits and property and casualty agencies across the United States. We're currently ranked the 25th-largest broker in the U.S. by Business Insurance and were named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies. With over 2,100 employees operating in 150+ locations across more than 45 states, our collaborative model gives every person and every agency the resources and support they need to grow, while each agency keeps its own identity, culture, and way of doing business. That growth has never been about numbers alone; it's about the people behind them.

*Patriot Growth Insurance Services is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship or immigration status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, and training. Patriot makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. For more information, read through our EEO and DE&I Policy located on our website at* *www.patriotgis.com**.*

Company Information
  
Headquartered in St. Augustine, FL, with offices and manufacturing facilities all around the globe, Amphenol CIT is one of the world’s leading designers and manufacturers of high-performance wire, cable, and medical devices. We provide complete interconnect solutions to industries like Aerospace, Military & Defense Electronics, Space, Medical, Test & Measurement, and Industrial.
  
  
Our talented team of employees worldwide helps bring movies to your seat on airplanes, deliver mission-critical information from drones to the command office, transfer heart rhythm to paper, route communications from space, connect power to downhill oil drills, and get planes back in the air faster. At Amphenol CIT, we make the amazing possible. Take the next step to become an integral part of our team by applying today and kickstart your journey with us.
  
  
SUMMARY
  
The Product Management Coordinator (PMC) supports Product Managers with daily tasks requiring interface and follow-up with both internal and external customers. The PMC assists the Product Manager in the execution of activities related to evaluating product line health and securing profitable new business. The product management (PM) team is responsible for finding and eliminating barriers to success for the product line, and as such, PM staff must be willing to engage with all functional departments internal and external to Amphenol. PMC position is an opportunity to develop excellent product and company knowledge and grow into customer-facing or operations roles. The PMC role is ideal for someone with a strong desire to learn, to support customers, and to contribute to building new projects and opportunities.
  
  
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

* Provide product samples
* Provide sales documents, such as brochures, battlecards, etc.
* Update PowerPoint presentations

**With direction from the Product Manager:**

* Create and maintain price sheets

* Assist in developing marketing-related content

Other duties will be assigned

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

* Excellent customer support and communication skills; ability to work professionally, empathetically, and effectively on the telephone, through email and through written correspondence.

372d8a14f767a2557d2a.title: Market Area Coordinator
372d8a14f767a2557d2a.description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Remote

  

**In this position..**.

The Market Area Coordinator (MAC) serves as the strategic market leader and primary connection point between Ford strategy, MarketSource execution, market intelligence, and dealer outcomes.
  
The MAC is responsible for translating Ford's technician workforce priorities into a coordinated market strategy, establishing priorities for the TCS team, allocating resources based on dealer need and opportunity, and ensuring measurable improvement in technician workforce outcomes.
  
The MAC provides strategic oversight and governance for six TCS resources while maintaining alignment with Ford Regional Teams, dealer leadership, training and education partners, New Ford Tech, and other relevant Ford business partners.

**What you'll do...**

Success in this role is measured by market-level dealer outcomes, technician workforce improvement, TCS effectiveness, program adoption, cost efficiency, and return on investment — not simply activity volume.

**Key Responsibilities**
  
**1. Market Strategy & Workforce Planning**
  
Own the workforce strategy for the assigned market and establish priorities based on dealer needs, workforce data, market intelligence, and Ford strategic objectives.

* Own market-level technician workforce priorities and strategic objectives.

• Identify high-risk and high-opportunity dealerships.
  
• Analyze market trends, workforce gaps, retention challenges, recruiting needs, training requirements, and technician capacity.
  
• Establish TCS priorities and market engagement strategies.
  
• Identify emerging workforce trends and risks before they become critical issues.
  
• Prioritize TCS resources toward dealerships and opportunities with the greatest potential impact.
  
• Develop and maintain a market-level view of technician supply, demand, retention, pipeline, capacity, and readiness.
  
• Translate market intelligence into actionable recommendations for Ford and MarketSource leadership.  
  

**2. TCS Leadership & Governance**
  
Provide strategic direction, coaching, prioritization, and performance governance for TCS resources.

* Manage and provide strategic direction to TCS resources.

• Establish clear market priorities and expectations for TCS execution.
  
• Balance TCS workloads based on dealer complexity, geography, workforce need, and business opportunity.
  
• Ensure the appropriate TCS resource is assigned to each dealer opportunity.
  
• Review dealer assessments, engagement strategies, and action plans.
  
• Monitor execution against market priorities and performance objectives.
  
• Identify resource constraints and adjust assignments as market conditions change.
  
• Coach TCSs on consultative dealer engagement, workforce strategy, and outcome-based execution.
  
• Ensure TCS activity is focused on measurable dealer outcomes rather than activity volume.
  
• Identify and escalate performance or resource issues requiring leadership intervention.  

**3. Ford & Strategic Partner Alignment**
  
Serve as the primary market-level connection point between MarketSource and Ford stakeholders. Build and maintain strong relationships with:

* Ford Regional Teams

• Dealer leadership
  
• Ford and Lincoln dealerships Training and education partners
  
• New Ford Tech
  
• Technical schools and colleges
  
• Relevant Ford business partners
  
• Other workforce and technician development stakeholders

**4. Dealer Escalation & Strategic Intervention**
  
Serve as the escalation point for significant or complex dealer workforce challenges.
  
Escalation areas may include:

* Critical technician shortages

• Significant technician retention issues
  
• Persistent 0–2 year technician attrition
  
• Major recruiting or pipeline challenges
  
• Significant training or certification gaps
  
• Technician capacity constraints
  
• Complex dealer workforce challenges
  
• Tools, equipment, diagnostic, or technology readiness concerns
  
• Operational issues requiring cross-functional support
  
  
The MAC will determine the appropriate level of intervention and coordinate resources to develop and execute solutions.  
  

**5. Market Performance & Accountability**
  
Own the performance of the assigned market and ensure TCS activities translate into measurable dealer outcomes.
  
Monitor and report performance across:

* Technician retention

• Early-career technician retention
  
• Technician placements and growth
  
• Technician pipeline development
  
• Training and certification
  
• Technician capacity
  
• Service operations impact
  
• Tools, equipment, diagnostics, and technology readiness
  
• Program adoption
  
• Dealer action-plan execution
  
• Dealer satisfaction
  
• TCS productivity
  
• Cost per dealer
  
• Return on investment (ROI)
  
  
The MAC will establish market-level performance targets, monitor progress, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions when performance is off target.

**6. Market Intelligence & Continuous Improvement**
  
Use data, dealer feedback, and TCS insights to identify opportunities to improve the overall program.

* Aggregate TCS dealer intelligence into market-level insights.

• Identify common dealer workforce challenges and emerging trends.
  
• Identify successful practices that can be replicated across the market.
  
• Recommend process, program, or resource improvements.
  
• Use performance data to optimize TCS resource allocation.
  
• Provide leadership with actionable market intelligence and recommendations.
  
• Support continuous improvement of the TPS operating model.  
  
  
  
  

**You'll have...**

* Associates degree required

• 2–5+ years of professional experience in automotive or manufacturing environment
  
• Ability and willingness to travel frequently (approximately 65%), including overnight and out-of-state travel
  
• Strong understanding of dealership Parts and Service operations, technician productivity, and service capacity
  
• Experience in project or program management and business planning
  
• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, follow through, and solve problems quickly
  
• Willingness to relocate now or in the future
  
• Valid, unrestricted driver’s license  
  

**Even better, you may have...**

* Bachelor’s degree

• Experience in automotive service and support
  
• Strong communication, collaboration, organization, and presentation skills
  
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Teams, and SharePoint
  
• Familiar with Ford systems, including PTS and STARS

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage

• Paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more
  
• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
  
• Tuition assistance
  
• Established and active employee resource groups
  
• Paid time off for individual and team community service

8bc0381a57d07eb07bae.title: Patient Care Coordinator
8bc0381a57d07eb07bae.description:
When someone calls us, they're usually having a bad week. They're in pain. Or six weeks out from surgery. Or scared they aren't going to get their mobility back. Whoever picks up that call decides whether they feel like a case number, or like they've finally found someone who's got them.

We're hiring the person who answers that call.

**ABOUT US**

Next Level Rehab is a small, family-owned physical therapy practice in Asheville, NC. We specialize in aquatic therapy and in-home physical therapy, and every patient gets one-on-one care. Many of them are older adults working through pain, surgery recovery, or a loss of mobility. Our patients have given us a 5.0-star rating on Google, and we work hard to keep it that way.

We're looking for a Patient Care Coordinator who's kind, dependable, and highly organized, and who wants part-time work that makes a real difference in people's lives.

**THE ROLE AT A GLANCE**

* **Schedule**: Monday-Thursday, 1:00-5:00 PM Eastern (16 hours a week). There is some flexibility on the exact hours for the right person. The 16 hours a week is what's fixed.
* **Pay**: $21-23 per hour, part-time W2 employee. This is above the typical local market rate for this role.
* **Benefits**: Six paid holidays
* **Location**: Remote. Asheville / Western North Carolina strongly preferred, since you'll be scheduling patients across the area and knowing it helps. Elsewhere in the Eastern time zone considered for the right person.
* **Reports to**: Haley McCloskey, Owner & COO
* **Start date**: November 2026

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Own the phones during your shift**

* Answer our office and operations phone lines, plus voicemails and texts, 1:00-5:00 PM, Monday-Thursday. Expect roughly 10-15 calls in a shift.
* Handle new patient inquiries, reschedules, cancellations, and general questions
* Answer basic billing questions, and set up a callback for anything more detailed
* Know when to pass a call on: clinical, insurance, and sales calls go to the right teammate
* Return voicemails and messages the same day, or within one business day
* Never give clinical advice. You'll connect patients with the right person on our team instead.

**Schedule patients**

* Book evaluations and ongoing visits in our electronic medical record system (Heno)
* Match patients with the right therapist based on location, pool times, and availability
* Fill late-cancellation openings so patients can get care sooner

**Welcome new patients**

* Complete the intake form during a patient's first call
* Set up new patient accounts in Heno
* Send intake and outcome measure forms, and welcome emails
* Check insurance benefits
* Request referrals from doctors' offices, check faxes, and upload documents to patient records

**Support the team**

* Call patients after discharge to check in
* Handle data entry and other admin tasks as needed
* As you get comfortable in the role, help with outreach or other projects

**WHO YOU ARE**

You're reliable: you're on time, and when you say you'll finish something, you finish it, all the way. You catch details other people miss. You're warm and patient on the phone, even when a caller is frustrated or hurting, and people can tell you care. You stay organized and work well on your own without someone checking in.

**Required**

* At least 2 years of customer service experience
* A caring, compassionate, and professional manner, including in difficult conversations
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through
* Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously
* Ability to stay organized and follow processes closely
* Comfortable with technology and able to learn new software quickly
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel and Word, Gmail, and Google Calendar

**Preferred**

* Experience in healthcare or a medical office
* Familiarity with the Asheville / WNC area
* A bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Spanish language skills

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 90 DAYS**

* Every voicemail and text returned the same day
* New patient accounts set up in Heno accurately the first time, without rework
* Late-cancellation openings filled instead of sitting empty
* Patients who've spoken with you mention you by name
* You're running the afternoon independently, and nobody is checking behind you

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED**

* Your own computer and reliable high-speed internet
* A private, quiet workspace where patient conversations and information stay confidential
* A reliable smartphone that can run the Google Voice app
* Availability Monday-Thursday, 1:00-5:00 PM Eastern, every week
* Willingness to complete a background check and sign a HIPAA confidentiality agreement

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply through this posting, and include a short cover letter telling us why this role caught your eye.

Next Level Rehab is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

Pay: $21.00 - $23.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Can you reliably work 1-5 PM Eastern, Monday–Thursday, every week?
* Do you have a private, quiet workspace for confidential patient calls?
* Do you have your own computer and reliable high-speed internet?
* Are you located in the Asheville / WNC area?

Experience:

* Customer service: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

**Position Summary**
====================

Responsible for placing outbound and receiving inbound calls to patients, care givers, and health care professionals regarding patient medications, adherence, and prescription barriers related to the patient. This role is under the supervision of the Pharmacy Operations Manager and Pharmacy Intake Coordinator.

**Primary Key Performance Areas**
=================================

**KPA 1 – Data entry, documentation, and navigation**

Ensure the accurate and timely documentation of patient information into multiple software systems.

* Monitor timely creation of orders in e-prescribe and ensure accurate patient demographic information is loaded into the patient profile in CPR+.
* Able to navigate and accurately document information in CPR+/ORCA, ONCO EMR, and any additional pharmacy applications when needed.
* Review the daily Onco inbox report and document trends.
* Ensure complete and accurate patient setup in our operating systems.

**KPA 2 – Pharmacy Help Desk**

Communication and Documentation via pharmacy helpdesk tickets in Fresh Service, CPR+, ONCO EMR, and ORCA.

* Will facilitate communication between AON Pharmacy, the Pharmacy Liaison, Company clinics, Company Healthcare physicians/ practitioners, other Company departments and outside vendors.
* Monitor Fresh Service helpdesk requests and ensure responses to clinics are thorough, accurate, and timely.

**KPA 3 – Specialty pharmacy follow-up and staff support**

* SP follow-up to assure orders are being processed efficiently.
* Communicate with patient and clinic as to status of prescription.
* Will monitor daily activities and provide backup support where needed, including PA, PAP, SP follow-ups, BV and claims adjudication as needed.
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

**KPA 4 – Pharmacy call center communication and Customer Service**

Ensure effective communication and premier customer service with all internal and external customers.

* Will bridge the gap between patients and other specialty pharmacies by overseeing timely follow up by means of phone, e-mail or portal communication with specialty pharmacies.
* Demonstrate the ability to actively listen and understand patient questions and provide accurate answers and solutions. Will ensure that all phone calls are addressed professionally, courteously and in a timely manner.
* Act as a liaison between teams to communicate changes and help improve interdepartmental processes to improve patient care.
* Review incoming team emails to verify they are answered in a timely and professional manner.

**KPA 5 – Compliance**

Ensure all local, state, and federal guidelines are followed as well as corporate policies, pharmacy Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and accreditation bureaus’ standards.

* Verify all department compliance training is completed by the established deadlines.
* Maintain continuing education requirements for licensure.
* Maintain and ensure the confidentiality of all patient and employee information as required by the HIPAA regulations. Will assist department management in ensuring the storage, collection, and destruction of all Protected Healthcare Information is adherent to all federal and state guidelines, in addition to all accreditation standards.
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

**Position Qualifications/Requirements**
========================================

**Education**

* High school education required

**Certifications/Licenses**

* Active/Unrestricted Pharmacy Technician permit in the state of residence. Willing to obtain Florida Technician permit (if applicable).

**Previous Experience**

* Two years’ experience in specialty, retail, mail order, or hospital pharmacy as a pharmacy technician is required.

**Core Capabilities**

* **Analysis & Critical Thinking:** Critical thinking skills including solid problem solving, analysis, decision-making, planning, time management and organizational skills. Must be detailed oriented with the ability to exercise independent judgment.
* **Interpersonal Effectiveness:** Developed interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, diplomacy, tact, conflict management, delegation skills, and diversity awareness. Ability to work effectively with sensitive and confidential material and sometimes emotionally charged matters.
* **Communication Skills:** Good command of the English language. Second language is an asset but not required. Effective communication skills (oral, written, presentation), is an active listener, and effectively provides balanced feedback.
* **Customer Service & Organizational Awareness:** Strong customer focus. Ability to build an engaging culture of quality, performance effectiveness and operational excellence through best practices, strong business and political acumen, collaboration and partnerships, as well as a positive employee, physician and community relations.
* **Self-Management:** Effectively manages own time, conflicting priorities, self, stress, and professional development. Self-motivated and self-starter with ability work independently with limited supervision. Ability to work remotely effectively as required.
* Must be able to work effectively in a fast-paced, multi-site environment with demonstrated ability to juggle competing priorities and demands from a variety of stakeholders and sites.
* **Computer Skills:**

  + Proficiency in MS Office Word, Excel, Power Point, and Outlook required.
  + Proficiency in ONCO, ORCA, and CPR+ is preferred.

**Travel:** 0%

**Standard Core Workdays/Hours**: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM local residence time.

**Position Summary**  
Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner of federal health agencies. We anticipate future needs for Healthcare Consultant Managers to support our clients in the Veterans Health Administration (VHA). The selected candidate(s) will be part of a multi-disciplinary team focused on providing project management and support across mission-focused programs. Healthcare Consultant Managers serve as the primary point of contact with aligned clients, ensuring high-quality project deliverables, timeliness, staffing, quality standards, and reporting requirements are met. The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing program start-up tasks, including stakeholder engagement activities, writing business cases, designing health care transformation pilots, developing program materials, and evaluating outcomes. All applicants must reside in the U.S.  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations Statement**  
To succeed in this job, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential duty. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

* Effectively collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including clinical and non-clinical staff from program coordinators to senior executives, to design clinical interventions.
* Perform current state analyses and create journey maps to illustrate future state proposals.
* Conduct industry research (primary and secondary) to understand leading clinical practices.
* Analyze existing practices and make recommendations for improvement.
* Lead the development of high-visibility deliverables and program artifacts, including business cases, change and communications plans, operations manuals, and evaluation plans.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), quality control plans, and operational workflows to enhance consistency and quality.

* Monitor performance metrics such as response rates, data quality, and operational effectiveness; implement improvements as needed.
* Lead and manage project teams, including staff and subcontractors, ensuring alignment with project goals and timelines.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team environment.
* Support the onboarding of new staff and ensure effective integration into project teams.
* Manage project schedules, budgets, and resource allocation effectively, and ensure compliance with federal contract requirements, performance standards, and reporting expectations.
* Maintain strong client relationships to support long-term growth and business development efforts.
* Identify opportunities to expand services within existing client engagements, including follow-on work and task orders; collaborate with leadership on capture activities and contribute to proposals.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree plus eleven (11) years of experience or master's degree and six (9) years of relevant experience working on engagements in a consulting organization, health-related government entity, or within a large integrated health care delivery system.
* Experience with project management methods and tools.
* Experience with consulting methodologies such as change management, process improvement, human-centered design, environmental/market analysis, and/or qualitative and quantitative research.
* Ability to independently and effectively facilitate work groups of diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to simplify complex ideas into clear, accessible information for diverse audiences; strong writing skills and ability to develop business cases, operations manuals, presentation decks, and communications.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint).

* Experience designing and developing new programs and interventions for health care improvement.

Actual compensation offered will be determined by a combination of factors, including but not limited to: the candidate's education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience;internal equity; geographic location; and contract and organizational requirements. **Job Summary**
---------------

The University of Michigan Shared Services Center (U-M SSC) is a customer service organization focused on providing user-friendly and cost-effective administrative services to the university community. The SSC offers key financial and human resource transaction services to customers.

The HR Coordinator Service processes HR transactions and is a service that U-M schools, colleges, and administrative units (collectively "units") opt-into. The SSC maintains a strong focus on customer service with expectations for timely and accurate processing of requests.

Reporting to the HR Coordinator Supervisor, the HR Coordinator Intermediate Associate serves as a member of the Human Resource Operations Team. You will provide administrative support to numerous University units across campus, engaging with them through a ticketing system. In this role, you will process job postings, job change requests, payroll changes, payroll reporting, special projects, other complex transactions, and audit inquiries. You will be working in a high-volume, transactional environment which requires strong attention to detail. This position is expected to meet productivity & accuracy standards.

**Responsibilities\***
----------------------

* Develop subject matter expertise in the area of HR through on-the-job training.
* Spend 80% of the time completing transactions.
* Handle a high volume of tickets using a case management tool to open, document, process, and resolve tickets.
* Manage job openings and HR job data in U-M software.
* Process employment records for staff, faculty, non-students, and students.
* Conduct resume review and interview scheduling.
* Work in a collaborative environment with business partners, customers, and colleagues.
* Participate in continuous process improvement projects.
* Other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications\***
-----------------------------

* High school diploma or equivalent
* 1+ years of experience providing customer service

* Long-term disability coverage

The University of Michigan, with an operating budget of more than $10 billion, is a leader in higher education. ### **Remote - USA | Technical Solutions Management**

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

**Summary**

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you’ll be responsible for planning and executing strategies to drive customer adoption and use of the Wiz platform. You will provide both strategic and technical guidance to customers throughout the Wiz journey, from onboarding to operationalization through to a successful renewal and expansion.

Technical expertise and strong customer-facing skills will be essential in addressing the needs of our customers. Serving as the bridge between customers and the broader Wiz team, you'll streamline collaboration between Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Support to deliver a cohesive customer experience.  
  
  
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* **Be a Wiz Product and Cloud Security Expert –** Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout your customers’ Wiz journey
* + Confidently navigate customers through deployment, configuration, and operationalization of Wiz using best practices and your existing cloud-security domain expertise
  + Serve as the primary technical contact for your book of customers, helping to solve technical questions and issues as they arise via email, meetings, Slack, and support tickets
  + Continuously monitor news related to emerging cloud security threats and further develop your domain expertise
  + Continuously stay abreast and enabled on new Wiz features and functionality
* **Drive Adoption, Business Value Realization, and Customer Satisfaction** – Ensure your book of customers are delighted and seeing value from their Wiz purchase
* + Help customers develop success plans with measurable goals throughout the Wiz lifecycle that align with their organizational security and compliance objectives
  + Act proactively, by leading the customer on a journey to full adoption and value, and promoting excellence in addressing Cloud, Code, and Runtime security risk
  + Use your expert knowledge of the Wiz platform and features to accelerate your customers’ success and attainment of value
  + Assist customers in project managing Wiz adoption and operationalization goals across business units and stakeholders
  + Help unblock adoption as necessary by working with both internal and external parties to resolve people, process, and technology issues
  + Drive and track your customers’ achievement of business goals and realization of value through Wiz
  + Report progress and results to key Wiz and customer stakeholders in executive-friendly communications and QBRs/executive briefings
* **Advocate for your Customers** – Understand, document, and represent your customers’ needs to internal Wiz stakeholders
* + Capture feature requests/adoption blockers and liaise with Product and Engineering teams to determine priority and alternative solutions

**Manage your book of business and support revenue objectives - Support and manage a book of up to 15 customers, depending on size and complexity****Identify opportunities for expansion and assist in securing renewals in partnership with sales and renewals teams.**

* + Drive towards utilization/adoption targets for your book of business
  + Identify, document, and action on risks (e.g, satisfaction, churn, renewal, tenant health) in customer engagements
  + Develop and cultivate close relationships with key customer contacts, from C-level to practitioner, to understand sentiment and drive forward key Wiz objectives

**Help build and scale a world-class TAM organization at a hyper-growth company – assist in driving improvements in Wiz’s TAM motion and have an impact across GTM teams** **Develop documentation, mentor associate TAMs, and develop areas of technical subject-matter expertise**

* + Partner cross-functionally with internal teams to improve processes

**What you’ll bring**

* **Overall**
* + **5-8+ years of experience** in technical customer-facing roles, ideally supporting a cloud / cloud-security product
  + - **For example:** Technical Account Manager, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, Customer Success Engineer, and Architect.
  + B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar field, or equivalent experience.
  + Ability and willingness to navigate nebulous job responsibilities while actively contributing to the further refinement of the TAM motion

**Technical Knowledge**

* + Strong understanding of cloud services and architecture of at least 1 CSP (AWS/GCP/Azure/OCI) – ideally, you have a CSP certification (e.g., Certified Solutions Architect, Certified DevOps Engineer)
  + Familiarity with cloud-security best practices, common threat models, and CNAPP use cases. Ideally, you have a security certification or experience helping organizations address cloud-security challenges
  + Familiarity with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), as well as the associated security considerations
  + Familiarity with DevOps technologies – CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Version Control Systems, etc.
  + Familiarity with Linux and Windows operating systems concepts and runtime sensing
  + Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and drive resolution across nebulous structures, both internal and external
  + Ability and willingness to continuously learn emerging cloud/security technologies

**Account Management and Customer Success**

* + Proven track record of successfully managing a book of business with 5-10+ customers
  + Proven track record of building and maintaining relationships with enterprise clients, driving customer outcomes, and exceeding performance targets
  + Ability and willingness to continuously enable customers on the Wiz platform and assist them in solving problems, ranging from trivial to highly complex
  + Willingness to work across multiple communication channels and platforms to assist your customers - e.g., responding to Slack messages, emails, and support tickets
  + Ability to use data and systems (e.g., CRM, log analysis tools) to monitor customer health and identify trends to inform customer success and retention initiatives.
  + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

**Compensation + Benefits**
