e35cb7dbde33a2fe7f35.title: Program Operations Coordinator
e35cb7dbde33a2fe7f35.description:
**Program Operations Coordinator- Job Posting**

**Today's Date:** October 22, 2026

**Application, Resume, and Cover Letter Due Date:** November 5, 2026 by 5pm Mountain Time

**Principal Location:** Lakewood, CO

**Position Role Type:** Full Time

**Salary Range:** $55,000-$75,000, starting salaries are typically at or near the lower end of the pay band and are commensurate with experience

  

**About this Position**

The Program Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating, supporting and improving key operational and logistical aspects related to new customer inquiries, implementation, and delivery of Sources of Strength programming. Responsibilities also include developing written deliverables and reports for internal and external audiences; communicating with external partners in a variety of formats; and fielding incoming questions from existing and potential customers.

This position requires consistent, clear, and effective communication; the ability to professionally collaborate across multiple internal departments; exceptional organizational skills as well as strong skills in task and time management, proactive planning, and creative problem-solving are required. This position also requires aptitude for clear and professional communication as well as a sense of accountability and resilience. Working with diverse communities, developing and sustaining positive relationships with a variety of clients, collaborators, state level partners, and colleagues is essential to this position. High levels of positivity, humility, humor, authenticity, accountability, and inclusivity are key traits for this position.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position requires exceptional organization and self-motivation, an aptitude for clear, kind, and professional communication, and established writing and interpersonal skills. The Program Operations Coordinator is essential to ensuring that training processes and coordination are clear, thorough, and well-communicated to local hosts, attendees, and training staff.

**Operational and Logistical Coordination**

* Schedule and support the coordination of training with organizations through phone calls, emails, video conferences, and calendar management.
* Update and maintain customer support, contract, and general information systems.
* Monitor and improve, as necessary, registration processes, curriculum order processes, and other related administrative workflows, and support long-term strategic planning.
* Send pre-training communications to hosts, attendees, and trainers (logistics, host checklists, registration, materials confirmation) using Airtable-driven templates and timelines
* Maintain the Sources of Strength Airtable operational database(s) and input accurate data consistently, including shipment tracking information for physical materials.
* Utilize Sources of Strength applications and platforms, including Google Calendar, Airtable, Fellow, Slack, Zoom, and the Google Office Suite.

**Partner Engagement & Account Management**

* Serve as a point of contact for new program interest inquiries, conducting 1:1 potential exploratory calls and participating in group webinar sessions with potential customers interested in implementation.
* Guide interested partners from first conversation through quote, and contract, with timely and consistent follow-up in collaboration with other staff.
* Track inquiries and pipeline status in Airtable and share trends with the Program Operations Supervisor
* Serve as the point of contact for executed contracts to ensure clear and consistent customer support and satisfaction as well as compliance with contract timelines and deliverables.
* Provide digital access to curriculum for schools that have purchased and been trained in the program, and analyze data to provide reports and recommendations on its effectiveness.
* Develop a regular reporting process detailing progress on contract deliverables and spend-down information for both internal and external audiences.

**Materials Management**

* Manage program materials inventory, monitor reorder points, forecast needs, and improve operational efficiency
* Process material orders and serve as the main point of contact with our external warehouse partner
* Track and share shipping information internally and with partners, and resolve delays or order issues in collaboration with other staff.
* Vet vendors, negotiate material prices, and manage supplier relationships.
* Participate in regular meetings with the Program Operations Supervisor and the Sources warehouse vendor to coordinate and align material-related processes, monitor reorder points, and problem-solve material-related issues.

**Communications, Tracking, and Reporting**

* Provide consistent, clear, courteous, and effective communication with internal and external partners.
* Support internal and external communications through various platforms including emailed newsletters, social media posts, blogs, etc.

**Special projects, professional development, and/or other duties as assigned**

* Engage in and perform short-term or one-time individual or team projects, based on organizational need and individual skills, strengths, professional development goals, or special interests;
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned to support organizational objectives and priorities.

***As a Sources of Strength Team Member***

* Attend regular staff meetings, wellness, and professional development days, supervisory meetings w/ supervisor, and in person staff retreats;
* Approach the process of social change in diverse communities (indigenous, rural, urban, suburban, conservative/progressive, religious/secular, etc.) with compassion and curiosity, and an understanding that differences in perspective, belief, and opinion are an opportunity for conversation, growth, and education for the communities we work with;
* Pursue wellness in your own life by cultivating regular practices around mental health, well-being, resilience, and by engaging our sources of strength;
* Complete necessary administrative tasks including expense reports, and timesheets;
* Follow all company policies and procedures outlined in our Employee Handbook;
* Engage with and participate in suicide prevention coalitions, committees, task forces, etc. in your local community, state, or region, representing yourself and Sources of Strength in giving back to and being involved in your community;
* Contribute to creating an equitable and inclusive environment internally and externally by honoring the dignity of others, embracing curiosity over fear, communicating respectfully, and committing to a growth mindset in personal development.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Professional & Communication Skills**

* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Strong public speaking and presentation skills
* Excellent customer service and relationship-building skills
* Strong conceptual, networking, troubleshooting, and interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated ability to represent the organization in a professional and ethical manner

**Operations, Organization, & Problem Solving**

* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to problem-solve
* Excellent organizational, data analysis, and processing skills
* Excellent time management skills
* Ability to work collaboratively and effectively handle multiple projects on various timelines

**Collaboration & Feedback**

* The ability to give and receive feedback
* Receive and provide professional, honest, compassionate, and transparent feedback with community partners and customers, your direct supervisor, colleagues, and organizational leadership
* Ability to work collaboratively with Sources of Strength colleagues, including the training team, your direct supervisor, and organizational leadership
* Participate in annual performance planning and review process, working collaboratively with your direct supervisor and organizational leadership

**Technical Skills**

* Ability to navigate and use basic audio/visual equipment, presentation software (Zoom), and workplace software (Slack, Airtable, Google Suite, and online platforms including Brevo, DocSend, CustomPoint, Fillout, etc.)

**Culture, Diversity & Mindset**

* Commitment to open and direct communication, organizational change, and creating a positive work environment
* An inclusive mentality that recognizes and celebrates diversity
* Commitment to actively research, learn, and seek understanding about the diverse communities we serve, independently and in collaboration with Sources of Strength staff
* Good sense of humor

Travel may be required up to 20% of the time for training, staff events, and partner engagement.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Strongly encouraged to be fully vaccinated and boosted for COVID-19 and the influenza virus.
* Continuously required to sit/stand;
* Occasionally required to walk, bend, stoop, push/pull, and reach above;
* Occasionally required to lift and carry 10 to 50 pounds.

**Additional desired (but not mandatory) areas of expertise:**

* Previous experience with Sources of Strength programming as an Adult Advisor, certified trainer, or implementing school or community staff.
* Previous experience or competence with Airtable or similar database system.
* Prior experience with marketing, sales, communications, or social media experience
* Knowledge of the educational ecosystem

**About Sources of Strength**  
The Sources of Strength mission is To Empower a Well World. We do this by training, supporting, and empowering both youth and adults to positively impact their world through the power of connection, hope, help, and strength. Sources of Strength has become one of the most heavily researched and widely disseminated mental health promotion and upstream prevention programs in the country. We work with schools and communities to increase mental health and wellbeing at an individual, relational, and communal level to reduce risk of suicide, violence, and other adverse outcomes. Sources works in elementary, secondary, university, community, and workplace settings with a focus on creating positive culture change that increases wellness and decreases risk.

Sources of Strength believes that the work of empowering a well world must include working towards justice, equity, inclusivity, and belonging. Individuals, communities, and societies cannot be truly healthy and whole where injustice, inequity, and exclusion exist. We truly believe that a diverse and representative team makes our work stronger, more authentic, and more effective in the communities we serve. We welcome all members of the team to join in co-creating a dynamic organizational culture and shaping the products and services we provide. At Sources of Strength, we also believe that employee physical, mental, and spiritual wellness are critical to our ability to empower a well world, making employee wellness an organizational priority.

**Competitive benefits package:**

* Profit Share Bonus Structure
* Employee Ownership (ESOP)
* 4-day Workweek
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Matching Retirement Contribution (401k)
* Fully paid Medical, Vision, Long Term and Short Term Disability Insurance
* Generous Family Insurance Policy Coverage
* Health Savings Account Contributions by Employer
* Flexible Work/Life Balance
* Employee Wellness Oriented Culture
* Social Enterprise Mission Oriented Business Model

**Cover Letter Instructions:**

In your cover letter please tell us 1) Why this work, and why Sources of Strength. What draws you to upstream prevention and wellness work? and 2) More about your organization and problem-solving skils, specifically:

* Tell us about a time you coordinated something with many details, people, and deadlines, such as an event, a rollout, or an ordering process. What system did you use to stay organized, and what did you do when something fell through the cracks?  
  OR
* Tell us about a time a system, process, or workflow wasn't working well. How did you figure out what the problem was, what did you change, and what was the result?

**Application Process:**

* Applications are due by 5pm Mountain Time on November 5, 2026
* A review of your application may move you to the first step of the interview process with a phone screening
* Phone screenings are anticipated to occur the week of November 16
* Initial interviews are anticipated to occur the week of November 30
* Final panel interviews, as needed, are anticipated to occur the week of December 7 and December 14
* Expected start date in January but we will remain flexible to accommodate the needs of our top candidate.

6f7b7267a1eea754921c.title: Buyer I
6f7b7267a1eea754921c.description:
**Description of Position**
---------------------------

***\*\*\*Please note: this position is required to be onsite Monday through Friday from 8 am to 5 pm*** ***with the opportunity to potentially work remotely one day per week, upon satisfactory performance and after being fully trained (approximately 6 – 12 months).\*\*\****

  
The Buyer I supports responsible, transparent, and service-oriented procurement and contracting practices for Yavapai College. The position reviews and processes requisitions and purchase orders, assists with informal sourcing and competitive procurement activities, maintains supplier and contract records, supports contract administration, and provides responsive guidance to college departments and suppliers. The Buyer I applies established College policies, procedures, approval requirements, and ethical standards while developing the knowledge and judgment necessary for progressively more complex procurement assignments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review purchase requisitions, specifications, quotes, scopes of work, funding information, approvals, and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, policy compliance, and appropriate procurement methods.
* Communicate with requestors, Purchasing Liaisons, Budget Managers, suppliers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve discrepancies, obtain missing documentation, and maintain timely workflow.
* Create, issue, revise, and expedite purchase orders in ESM Purchase; monitor delivery and performance issues and assist with order, invoice, receiving, and change-order resolution.
* Assist with supplier sourcing and selection by researching available sources, College contracts, State of Arizona contracts, cooperative contracts, and other competitively awarded options that may provide best value.
* Obtain and document competitive quotations for assigned purchases and support formal solicitations, including supplier outreach, solicitation documentation, bid or proposal receipt, evaluation support, award documentation, and maintenance of the procurement file.
* Train department liaisons with use of the procurement system, requisition preparation, required approvals, supporting documentation, and application of procurement thresholds and procedures.
* Review routine contracts, order forms, statements of work, quotes, and supplier terms for completeness and route documents for procurement, legal, risk, information technology, facilities, marketing, accessibility, security, or other required review.
* Work with the originating department, supplier, Senior Procurement Specialist, and Director to revise and finalize assigned contracts and purchasing documents consistent with college requirements and applicable law.
* Support negotiations involving pricing, discounts, delivery, payment terms, renewals, warranties, service levels, and other business terms; document negotiated savings or cost avoidance when applicable.
* Maintain assigned records in the College contract repository, including executed contracts, amendments, certificates of insurance, W-9 forms, renewal and termination dates, correspondence, approvals, and related procurement documentation.
* Monitor assigned contract milestones and provide timely notice to contract owners and procurement staff regarding renewals, expirations, insurance requirements, deliverables, and other required actions.
* Create and update supplier records, process credit applications, validate required supplier documentation, and help maintain accurate information in ESM, Banner ERP, M-Files, and related systems.
* Monitor and respond to the general Procurement & Contract Services email inbox; organize, route, track, and follow up on requests to provide timely and professional customer service.
* Assist with administration and database maintenance for the College purchase card program, including user listings, limits, card issuance, changes, and cancellations, as assigned.
* Maintain procurement records in accordance with applicable records-retention requirements and assist with responses to public records requests involving procurement and contract files.
* Maintain department schedules, agendas, logs, templates, standard forms, and other administrative records as assigned.
* Participate in training, cross-training, process improvement, system implementation, procedure updates, and professional development activities that improve service, compliance, efficiency, and continuity of operations.
* Perform other duties of a similar nature and level as assigned.

**Minimum Expectations & Requirements**
---------------------------------------

**Education:**
  
Associate degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  
  
**Experience:**  
A minimum of two years of related experience in procurement, purchasing, contracting, finance, business administration, or a closely related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  
  
**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams, as well as experience with Zoom audio and video conferencing.
* Ability to learn and use enterprise resource planning, e-procurement, contract repository, electronic signature, and supplier-management systems.
* Ability to review detailed documents, organize a high volume of work, meet deadlines, maintain accurate records, and exercise sound judgment within established procedures.
* Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with internal and external customers and to establish effective working relationships with college employees and suppliers.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality, avoid conflicts of interest, and apply ethical standards appropriate to public procurement.
* Ability to obtain the Certified Professional Public Buyer (CPPB) certification within a timeframe established by the College.
* Regular attendance and reliable performance of assigned duties.

**Preferred Skills & Abilities**
--------------------------------

**Education:**
  
Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain management, public administration, finance, or related field.
  
  
**Experience:**

* Experience in public procurement, government, community college, or higher education.

* Experience with ESM Purchase, Banner ERP, M-Files, or comparable procurement and contract management systems.
* Experience reviewing contracts, purchase terms, scopes of work, and supplier documentation.
* Experience negotiating pricing and business terms and identifying measurable cost savings or cost avoidance.

  
**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**  

* Knowledge of competitive quotations, solicitations, cooperative purchasing, sole-source documentation, supplier due diligence, insurance requirements, and contract administration.

* Strong customer service, administrative, analytical, writing, research, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to interpret and explain procurement procedures, thresholds, approval requirements, and documentation standards.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work both independently and collaboratively in a deadline-driven environment.
* Public service and customer focus
* Procurement ethics and accountability
* Accuracy and attention to detail
* Written and verbal communication
* Business judgment and problem solving
* Collaboration and relationship management
* Organization, prioritization, and follow-through
* Continuous learning and process improvement

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements and competencies listed represent the required knowledge, skill, and ability. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
  
  
**Physical Demands**
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
  
  
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee must frequently use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. In addition, the employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.
  
  
**Work Environment**
  
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

ef7b88c022a706c18f34.title: Legal Operations Associate (Remote)
ef7b88c022a706c18f34.description:
More than 80% of Americans own a car and see it as a fundamental necessity, yet the experience of owning one is stuck in the 90s. At Jerry.ai, we are building the first app to manage it all. Since launching in 2019, we’ve reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Jerry operates across the US and Canada, and our legal team keeps all of it running: entity filings, IP protection, product reviews, consumer escalations, and audits. The team is small, so this role comes with real scope early. You’ll run core legal operations and rebuild them with AI and low-code tools, so a small team can do the work of a much larger one.

The person who succeeds in this role is a natural driver: someone who owns a project from start to finish, solves complex problems without a manual, and has the grit to thrive in a startup environment. If you are eager to sit at the intersection of law, technology, and AI-driven efficiency, we want to hear from you.

**Why You Will (Or Won’t) Like Working Here**
---------------------------------------------

* **Real ownership early:** You report directly to our Legal Counsel and work closely with them across the team’s full scope. The projects you take on are yours from start to finish.
* **Room to build:** Many of our legal processes are still being optimized. You’ll decide how they should work and build the systems behind them.
* **Building and operating:** Alongside the building, a large share of the job is recurring work: filings, deadlines, and audits that have to be done exactly right, every time. Your accuracy keeps Jerry in good standing in every jurisdiction, and people who enjoy both sides of the role do well here.
* **Growth that tracks results:** You’ll learn from leaders who come from Amazon, Better, LinkedIn, McKinsey, BCG, and Bain. Promotion is based on performance and ownership alone, so strong work moves you forward fast.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

* **Automation:** Use AI and low-code tools to replace manual legal tasks with workflows that run on their own.
* **Legal and regulatory projects:** Work with our Legal Counsel on legal research, contract reviews, and other substantive projects as new questions come up.
* **Entity compliance:** Keep Jerry’s corporate entities in good standing across the US and Canada, handling annual reports and state requests end to end on your own.
* **Brand protection:** Monitor Jerry’s intellectual property, find infringements, and initiate cease-and-desist workflows.
* **Consumer escalations:** Investigate complex escalations to their root cause, recommend fixes, and turn recurring issues into compliance training for teams across the company.
* **Product compliance reviews:** Review products and processes for compliance risk and user friction, then work with Engineering and Product to fix the underlying issue.
* **Compliance audits:** Lead audits across operations and keep watch on the highest-risk areas between them.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **A Closer:** You track every open item until it’s done, and you find the answer yourself before asking someone else for it.
* **A Builder:** The second time you do a task by hand, you start working out how to automate the third. You reach for a spreadsheet or a low-code tool before a manual checklist.
* **A Zero-Error Operator:** Regulatory filings and audits leave no room for mistakes, and you work accordingly. You keep your own system so no deadline or cross-functional project slips.
* **A Proactive Communicator:** You provide updates without being chased, flag blockers early, and make sure teammates know what happens next.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You can take an unclear brief, define the problem yourself, and move on it with urgency.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* A Bachelor’s degree from an academically rigorous program, with a record of high performance.
* A track record of owning projects start to finish and solving problems without being told how, at school, at work, or on your own.
* Demonstrated interest in using AI and technology to improve how work gets done, such as a tool, automation, or process you built yourself.

*While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.*

***Please note:*** ***Jerry.ai*** ***is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.***

*Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.*

*Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at* *recruiting@jerry.ai*

*The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.*

*We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.*

**About Jerry.ai**

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

Compensation Range: $65K - $80K

0e60b34b273311b74753.title: Route Logistics Analyst - Territory Support - Remote
0e60b34b273311b74753.description:
Summit School Services companies share a strong commitment to provide the highest level of transportation safety, quality transportation, outstanding customer service and positive employee relations. Our corporate headquarters, located in Warrenville, Illinois, houses the administrative and corporate support functions for the organization. Our 250+ local customer service centers (CSCs) are supported by regional operations teams located throughout North America.

Summit School Services is seeking a Route Logistics Analyst - Territory Support to support an assigned territory and help improve the efficiency, service quality, and performance of our student transportation network.

This role is responsible for analyzing routing and transportation data, evaluating current route performance, identifying inefficiencies, and developing practical solutions that improve service while maximizing the use of vehicles, drivers, time, and other operating resources.

The Route Logistics Analyst will partner closely with local operations teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to evaluate routing scenarios, solve complex transportation challenges, support new business opportunities, and implement routing improvements. This role will also serve as a subject matter resource for routing technology, software troubleshooting, training, and large-scale routing projects.

Success in this role requires someone who can move comfortably between data analysis, operational problem-solving, customer consultation, routing technology, and project execution. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced transportation environment, and able to translate complex routing data into clear, actionable recommendations that can be implemented in the field.

This position reports to the Director of Route Logistics and may be based at Summit School Services’ corporate headquarters in Warrenville, Illinois, or remotely. Travel throughout North America is approximately 10–15%

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct routing and logistics studies and analyses, including tier analysis, school bell time analysis, ridership analysis, and future service requirements.
* Analyze current and historical route operations and customer service performance to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, service delivery, and resource utilization.
* Develop, analyze, and evaluate alternative routing scenarios and recommend solutions that improve service, operating efficiency, and revenue opportunities.
* Identify recurring routing issues, trends, deficiencies, and root causes, and develop strategic solutions and action plans to improve routing processes, technology, and standards.
* Develop routing strategies for existing contracts and create route scenarios to support new business development opportunities.
* Consult with customers to understand transportation needs and expectations and develop and present recommended routing solutions.
* Serve as a routing subject matter resource for Customer Service Centers within the assigned territory.
* Lead, plan, and execute complex routing projects involving cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
* Support internal and external customers with routing questions, issues, and troubleshooting.
* Train internal and external customers on routing principles, processes, and routing software.
* Manage new-router training for Versatrans and Traversa, as well as refresher training for existing users.
* Serve as a point of contact for Traversa and other routing software support requests from the field.
* Assist with the setup, integration, and troubleshooting of routing and dispatching software.
* Attend internal and external customer meetings virtually or onsite to identify project requirements, provide consultation, and present project findings and recommendations.
* Prioritize and resolve a high volume of routing support requests, particularly during school startup and peak summer periods.
* Partner with Operations Improvement and other cross-functional teams to develop and implement routing standards, best practices, and process improvements.

  
The salary range is $67k - $80k annually.

**Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Transportation, Supply Chain, Business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* Three or more years of operational experience in ground transportation, routing, logistics, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience applying logistics principles, tools, and techniques to develop and implement efficient transportation solutions.
* Experience in student transportation is preferred but not required.
* Experience using routing or transportation software such as Versatrans, Traversa, Transfinder, Trapeze MapNet, Edulog, or similar platforms.
* Ability to analyze multiple routing scenarios and recommend solutions based on service, cost, capacity, operational, and customer requirements.
* Knowledge of routing constraints, customer service expectations, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and contract requirements.
* Project management knowledge or experience working within cross-functional project teams.
* Experience training, coaching, or supporting users on software, routing principles, or operational processes.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal, teamwork, and relationship-building skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex routing or logistics concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, particularly during school startup periods.
* Ability to travel throughout North America approximately 10–15%.

*Summit School Services has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with its policies and values, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, abuse of authority, and discrimination. 3b42d6021db0999e99b7.title: Contact Center Operations and Transformation Functional Senior Consultant
3b42d6021db0999e99b7.description:
**Contact Center Operations and Transformation Functional Senior Consultant**  
  
Our Deloitte Sales & Service team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on December 31, 2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte Consulting's Customer offering portfolio, you will help clients transform contact center and customer service operations to drive efficiency, improve customer and employee experiences, and enable more scalable, data-driven service delivery. You will work at the intersection of business transformation, operations, technology, and AI, helping clients assess current-state service models, define future-state capabilities, and implement solutions that improve performance and reduce cost.  
  
You will advise clients on a range of customer operations priorities, including contact center transformation, digital channel enablement, operating model redesign, workforce optimization, service personalization, and AI-powered service innovation. This role requires a leader who can move seamlessly from executive-level discussions to detailed problem-solving, solution design, and delivery execution.  
  
Key responsibilities include:  

* Leading contact center operations and transformation engagements for clients across various industries
* Assessing current-state customer service operations, including organizational structure, service demand, channel strategy, call drivers, workforce management, agent experience, service levels, technology capabilities, cost structure, and performance metrics
* Designing future-state operating models that improve efficiency, scalability, resiliency, service quality, and customer satisfaction
* Developing transformation strategies that leverage digital self-service, automation, Generative AI, conversational AI, agent assist, intelligent routing, knowledge management, process redesign, and workforce optimization
* Helping clients use AI, analytics, and customer data to improve service performance, personalize interactions, reduce handle time, increase containment, improve first-contact resolution, and support better decision-making
* Supporting the design and implementation of contact center and customer service technologies, including CCaaS, CRM, workforce management, quality management, knowledge management, analytics, and AI-enabled service platforms
* Leading digital service transformation efforts to modernize customer engagement across contact center, digital, and assisted-service channels
* Managing multiple teams and workstreams, while driving high-quality delivery, measurable client impact, and strong team performance
* Building trusted client relationships and collaborating across Deloitte's cross-functional teams, including operations, technology, AI, data, industry, and delivery specialists, to deliver integrated solutions
* Coaching junior team members, contributing to team development, and supporting Deloitte's collaborative, client-focused culture

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationship
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.  
  
Qualifications  
  
Required  

* 6+ years of relevant experience in contact center operations, customer service transformation, or management consulting/advisory, including significant experience focused on contact center strategy, operations, and transformation engagements
* 2+ years of experience leading multiple project teams and workstreams simultaneously, with responsibility for delivery quality, team performance, and client outcomes
* 2+ years of experience serving clients across various industries, with an understanding of customer operations, service environments, and industry-specific business challenges
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience

* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

  
Preferred  

* Experience working in, leading, or advising large-scale contact center environments supporting 500+ agents.
* Experience with contact center and customer service technologies, including CCaaS, CRM, workforce management, quality management, knowledge management, analytics, and AI-enabled service tools.
* Experience leveraging AI, automation, digital self-service, analytics, and personalization capabilities to improve customer service performance and reduce operating costs.
* Experience with Salesforce.
* Experience with Genesys, Five9, NICE, AWS, or similar cloud-based contact center and customer service platforms.
* Experience developing business cases, transformation roadmaps, operating models, performance improvement plans, and value realization frameworks.
* PMP, Six Sigma, Lean, Agile, or related certifications
* Master of Business Administration or other relevant advanced degree.

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $131,000 to $218,000.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

d5e656914c86c0352450.title: Operations Assistant, part-time, 20-29 hours per week
d5e656914c86c0352450.description:
The Operations Assistant provides essential transactional support and accurate documentation to position Auxilio as a valuable partner to Christian churches and non-profits. By ensuring that financial and administrative foundations are meticulously maintained, you enable ministry leaders to focus their energy on spreading the gospel.

### **About Auxilio Partners**

Are you looking for a vocation where your sense of calling and shared passion to serve God can be used for God's glory? Are you seeking to be part of a trusted team that helps our clients thrive as they proclaim the gospel in word and deed across the US?

Auxilio, in Latin, means “to help, support, partner, remedy.” Auxilio exists to serve Christian churches and faith-based nonprofits by being a trusted business partner. Our work allows church leaders to focus on their mission.

### **Description**

**About Auxilio Partners**
--------------------------

Are you interested in joining a team that supports Christian churches and non-profits? Auxilio exists to serve these organizations as a trusted business partner, allowing ministry leaders and executive directors to focus on spreading the Christian gospel across the U.S. If this mission resonates with you, we would love to welcome you on board.

Auxilio is a Christian-owned business that fosters a connected culture. We hold weekly staff meetings for business updates, offer support to one another, and pray for our clients, all to build a strong community.

We're looking for candidates residing and working in CO, DC, FL, GA, KY, MA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, PA, SC, TN, TX, and VA. Please note that we can only consider applicants who live and work in the listed states. We also welcome military spouses outside these states as long as they are legal residents of one of the hiring states (as qualified by the MSRRA). For recruiters, Auxilio will not use for-hire recruitment for this position, and does not give permission to be contacted.

**Duties/Responsibilities**
---------------------------

60% — Operational & Transactional Execution

* Financial Processing: Receive and enter vendor invoices into the bill pay system and prepare them for timely payment.
* Donation Management: Accurately process, batch, and receipt donations while maintaining comprehensive donation records.
* Expense Documentation: Ensure all credit card and other expense documentation is complete and accurate.
* Reconciliation Support: Assist the team with monthly account reconciliations to ensure financial integrity.

20% — Digital Record & Document Maintenance

* Information Organization: Maintain digital records for receipts, bank statements, donation documentation, and vendor/contractor information.
* HR & Payroll Admin: Organize and maintain critical employee payroll and human resources documents.
* General Support: Perform general office duties and assist in other operational areas as requested to support the team.

10% — Collaborative Coordination

* Partnership: Work closely with the Partner Strategist and Operations Specialist to provide exceptional, seamless service.
* Client Nuance: Learn the specific needs and nuances of multiple client accounts to move between them seamlessly.

10% — Auxilio Community

* Internal Connection: Participate in weekly staff meetings for prayer, business updates, and team support. Engaging in internal company spaces (when appropriate and comfortable) to nurture community, collaboration, and culture

### **Skills & Experience**

* Technical Skills: Familiarity with Mac OS, Google Workspace, Quickbooks Online, Bill.com, Church Management Software is a plus
* Other Skills: High attention to numerical detail, and the ability to learn new software systems quickly.
* Experience: Minimum of 2 years of general administrative experience or an Associate’s degree. Applications with experience with bookkeeping, payroll, or faith-based non-profits will be prioritized.

**Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------

You are a highly organized, self-motivated individual who thrives on accuracy and order. You understand that behind every invoice and donation record is a ministry that depends on your diligence to function. You are "transactionally oriented," meaning you find satisfaction in completing tasks precisely and on time, and you enjoy the challenge of supporting a diverse team in a mission-driven, remote environment.

**Here is what you can expect from us:**
----------------------------------------

Competitive compensation, sick time, paid holidays, and 401(k) with employer contribution.

Auxilio has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. Employees are paid within the salary range based on experience and the position's market data.

#### **Salary**

$22 - $24.5 per hour

0644c906121b72e34374.title: Inside Sales Associate, Partnerships
0644c906121b72e34374.description:
At Cogstate, we're advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate's assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we're supporting a multinational Alzheimer's trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we're not just imagining the future of brain health - we're building it.

That's why we're seeking a Inside Sales Coordinator, Partnerships accountable for managing and qualifying inbound sales opportunities generated through strategic partners and referral channels (primarily CRO and eCOA partners). This individual will serve as the central coordinator between partners, proposals, business development, science, operations and finance teams to ensure opportunities are fully qualified and move efficiently through the proposal and sales process.

Primary responsibilities include: developing relationships with Cogstate partners, qualification of inbound opportunities, coordination of budget development and proposal generation, maintenance of accurate opportunity tracking within Salesforce, facilitation of communication among internal stakeholders, and proactive follow-up activities in coordination with Business Development Directors to help manage sales process and improve win rates. The Inside Sales Associate may also be involved in outbound sales activity as directed by the Chief Commercial Officer in partnership with BD Directors.

This role is ideal for an individual who is extremely organized, enjoys managing multiple opportunities simultaneously, collaborating across functions, and actively working with external partners to help convert partner referrals into revenue-generating contracts.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Receive and manage inbound opportunities from strategic partners, including eCOA vendors, CROs, technology alliances, and other referral sources.
* Coordinate with BD Directors and conduct initial qualification to assess:
  + Sponsor name (or geographic location at minimum)
  + Management of mutual CDA agreements
  + Study specifications (including protocol synopsis if possible)
  + Budget requirements
  + Competitive positioning
  + Alignment with Cogstate Capabilities
  + Set expectations for proposal turnaround and determine if a ballpark or full budget is needed.
* Act as primary internal coordinator for inbound partner budget development activities
* Input new opportunities into Salesforce and provide specifications to proposal team to generate PIC
* Work with proposal team, BD Director for territory, and all Cogstate stakeholders to draft budget and proposal
* Monitor proposal turnaround times and escalate bottlenecks when necessary
* Ensure budgets and proposals align with commercial strategy and approved pricing guidelines.
* Maintain complete opportunity records within Salesforce.
* Ensure accuracy of:
  + Opportunity stage
  + Expected close dates
  + Probability assessments
  + Partner attribution
* Track activity metrics and conversion rates
* Identify stalled opportunities and implement follow-up plans
* Support forecasting and strategy to close opportunities in partnership with BD Directors
* Serve as a key point of contact for strategic partners regarding active, non-strategic opportunities Maintain regular communication with partners to obtain status updates and next steps
* Coordinate meetings and follow-up activities between stakeholders
* Build strong relationships with partner organizations and internal commercial teams
* Ensure timely responses to partner inquiries and opportunity requests
* Monitor sales cycle performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency
* Track pipeline metrics including:
  + Lead-to-opportunity conversion
  + Proposal conversion
  + Win rate
  + Sales cycle length
  + Partner performance
* Recommend process improvements that increase revenue generation and sales productivity
* Support implementation of commercial best practices and CRM standards.
* Work with BD Directors and Marketing colleagues as necessary to identify and engage with external sponsor contacts to promote understanding of Cogsate capabilities and identify new opportunities
* Assist BD Directors, as directed by CCO, in conference outreach and appointment setting, etc.

**Requirements**

  

* Successful experience managing partner-generated opportunities
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical and biotechnology drug development
* Bachelor's Degree (Business preferred)
* 2-5 years of experience in one of the following:
  + Business development support
  + Inside sales
  + Sales operations
  + Proposal management
  + Clinical research industry
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation abilities
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, especially Word, Excel and Copilot
* Experience supporting CRO, eCOA, RTSM, digital health, cognitive assessment, or clinical technology sales
* Familiarity with clinical trial budgeting and proposal development
* Familiarity with Salesforce and report generation preferred

**Skills, Knowledge and Specialist Expertise**

* Strong communication skills, both oral and written
* Understanding of drug development process
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail
* Technical proficiency with Copilot and emerging AI tools to help streamline account targeting, qualification, and process improvement preferred

**What's In It For You**

* In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in Cogstate's short-term incentive (STI) bonus program, with a target bonus opportunity of 5% of annual base salary, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan.
* Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
* Generous Paid Time-off: Cogstate employees receive 20 days of vacation leave, 10 days of personal leave and 10 paid public holidays.
* 401(k) Matching: As you invest in yourself and your future, Cogstate invests in you too: we match up to3% of your yearly salary in Cogstate's 401k program.
* Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the position.
* Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
* Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
* Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
* Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.

**Our Culture**  
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We're courageous and we deliver together. We're passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We're brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you're ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the company. If you need assistance in applying please email PeopleandCulture@cogstate.com.

**Privacy Notice for Job Applicants**

Cogstate is committed to protecting your personal data. We collect and process your information for recruitment purposes in compliance with applicable laws, including the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), and similar laws in other jurisdictions.

For more information on how we collect, use, and protect your data, and your rights under these laws, you can find Cogstate's privacy policy by clicking here.

926836dd670f0b251673.title: Solutions Delivery - Technical Project Manager
926836dd670f0b251673.description:
Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
This position is responsible for helping meet the business needs of the company by providing technical and administrative support, client management, coordination, project scheduling and tracking, training, quality assurance/testing, and technical guidance for the SaaS Customer Engagement Platform (CEP) products, as well as other applications that support Franklin’s energy service programs. The role shall be responsible for managing our business clients and support our client offering improvement initiatives for technology delivery services. This role works within a team environment and is expected to operate independently and in collaboration with other teams throughout the company, in all phases of Agile Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC).
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.
  
Client Management, Project Management and ownership of the success of client customer engagement solution solutions implementations reporting to the VP of Operations for Client Technology Services. This includes both managing the requirements gathering and implementation process for new clients as well as management of client operations for Franklin Energy’s customer engagement platform customer base. You will be responsible for key aspects of client management, requirements gathering, program scheduling and tracking, client communicates, assisting in testing, and managing reporting. You will work with developers to implement our technology products including developing an understanding of our Web, backend and database systems.
  

* Account Management, Project Management, Risk Management and Budget Management.
* Technical leadership during project planning and delivery for all aspects of our technology delivery services using Agile SLDC and including Web portal and API development, Data Ingestion, data management for reporting, Data file transfers, Database and IT Systems.
* Manage schedule, tasks assignments, coordinate resources for all aspects of the Program/Project Management and reporting of milestone.
* Develop and maintain RAID logs (Risk, Action, Issues and Decisions) to ensure business and assignment risks are identified, monitored, and managed.
* Development of technology deliverables for the different roles associated with our platform (Programs, CSRs, Contractors, etc.)
* Collaboration and Support PM’s and other personnel involved in respective account client implementations and operations.
* Facilitate the process for requirements gathering workshops and develop Business Requirements Documents (BRD)
* Customer Engagement Training for different roles associated with our platform (Programs, CSRs, Contractors, etc.)
* Managing and assisting quality assurance activities for your accounts
* Participate in Testing code, review, and implemented products as needed.
* Work directly with both our clients, set appropriate expectations and own the success of the project implementations.
* Identify and implement process improvement activities/projects, working with our clients, and product teams using best practices and creative thinking.
* Performs other duties as assigned by the VP of CEP Solutions.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS
  
Education and Experience
  

* Bachelor Degree from an accredited college or university in a technical or engineering discipline (preferred)
* 3+ years of related experience
* Previous exposure to Project Management methodologies and associated tools
* Strong Data Analytics skills
* Previous customer service/account management experience preferred
* Experience with energy efficiency program implementation preferred
* Proficiency in applicable process documentation tools (Visio, or equivalent) preferred
* Proficiency in applicable project scheduling tools (MS Project, or equivalent) preferred
* Advanced proficiency in implementing SaaS solutions preferred
* Familiarity with clean-tech is a plus

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities
  
  

* Excellent understanding of all phases of Agile Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC).
* Excellent understanding of Confluence, Jira Systems, Kanban board and SharePoint.
* Working experience in environment of Web portal and API development, Data Ingestion, data management for reporting, Data file transfers, Database, and IT Systems.
* Preferred experience with website development using PHP, HTML, CSS, Javascript and MySQL, larger database Cassandra.
* Strong understanding of data ingestion and tracking data in systems/databases, data extracts and data analytic.
* Good understanding of database, Tables and columns, proficiency in SQL preferred.
* The ability to work independently; collect data, analyze information, produce templates and reports.
* Ability to demonstrate and communicate the functionality of our technology offerings.
* Effective ability to work directly with clients and their customer base as required.
* Must be a detail-oriented, organized, self-starter, and have an ability to prioritize workload.
* Ability to identify and resolve any issues with PMs, customers and trade allies.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Must be able to handle a wide work variety and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Teams.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing with customers, clients, and employees.
* Committed to diversity and inclusion
* Reliable transportation

Licenses & Certifications
  

* PMP preferred but not required
* Valid driver’s license

**Compensation & Benefits:**  
Franklin Energy reasonably expects the starting salary for this position to fall between $108,000 and $125,000 annually. The final offer will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs. Franklin Energy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits; paid time off; paid holidays; and other company-sponsored benefits and programs.
  
  
Travel Requirements
  

* Willingness to travel up to 30%

**Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.
  
The above information describes the general duties and requirements necessary to perform the principle functions of the position. This shall not be construed as a detailed description of all the duties and requirements that may be necessary in this position.
  
An Equal Opportunity Employer

Because many roles at Franklin Energy involve regulatory compliance, safety responsibilities, or professional licensing requirements, it is critical that interview responses reflect the candidate’s direct knowledge and experience. Misrepresentation of technical or safety qualifications may result in immediate removal from consideration.
  
  
**Notice Regarding Automated Tools:**  
We may use automated or AI-assisted tools as part of our candidate evaluation process to assess job-related skills and qualifications. These tools are intended to support fair and consistent review and do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions. All evaluations are conducted in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

7ed12bde34cda8145997.title: Territory Sales Manager
7ed12bde34cda8145997.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Territory Manager

**LOCATION:** Bay Area, CA (Field-based; Requires extensive travel)

**REPORTS TO:** Regional Operations Manager

**The Company:**

Sunbit is a top ranked financial technology company headquartered in Los Angeles, California, revolutionizing how people manage everyday expenses with its cutting-edge Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution.

Trusted by over 30,000 locations nationwide—with a strong presence in dental practices and automotive dealerships (where more than 1 out of 2 dealerships are offering Sunbit)—Sunbit makes essential services more accessible, affordable, and convenient.

Founded in 2016, Sunbit has become the fastest, simplest, and most inclusive financing solution tailored for auto dealership service centers. By offering flexible payment options, Sunbit empowers service teams to complete more approved repair orders and ease the financial burden on customers—helping people say “yes” to the maintenance and repairs they need, when they need them.

Sunbit’s impact and innovation have been widely recognized. The company was named to the Inc. 5000 list in both 2022 and 2023, and has earned accolades such as Most Loved Workplace®, Best Point of Sale Company, and Top Fintech Startup by CB Insights. Sunbit is also featured on CB Insights' list of Unicorn Startup Companies, with a valuation of $1.1 billion. (Source: CB Insights Unicorn List)

With proven product to market fit and rapid success across thousands of merchants and millions of customers, Sunbit is expanding its Account Management team. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-performance, high-growth company that’s redefining how people pay for essential services—and helping our partners deliver more of them.

**﻿The Role:**

**﻿**At Sunbit, we help dental practices serve more patients every day by making the financing experience simpler, faster, and more accessible. As a Territory Manager, you will own a defined book of business and act as the strategic driver behind its growth.

This is not a cold-calling or hunting role. It is a highly consultative, sales-led account management position where you will partner deeply with practices, influence adoption behavior, and guide them toward meaningful, measurable outcomes.

You will become the expert on each practice’s business, uncover growth opportunities through strong discovery, and use data to drive performance.

You’ll work closely with DSOs, office managers, clinical teams, and internal Sunbit partners to ensure sustained success, helping to grow Sunbit to the #1 patient financing solution for dental practices across the US.

  
Requirements:  
  

**What You'll Own:**

* **﻿**Own and grow a defined book of business across dental practices and DSOs, driving consistent increases in Sunbit adoption, application velocity, and loan volume.
* Build trusted, long-term relationships with key decision makers: practice owners, DSOs, office managers, treatment coordinators, and front-office teams.
* Lead recurring performance reviews (monthly, quarterly) using practice data to highlight wins, uncover opportunities, and align on plans for growth.
* Deliver high-impact training and coaching for office teams to improve financial presentation skills, Sunbit workflows, and overall patient conversion.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Partner Success Managers, the Training Manager, Marketing, and Operations to support practice performance and execute territory strategies.
* Execute territory plans including routing, visit cadence, segmentation, and prioritized account focus based on performance trends.
* Maintain disciplined CRM management (activity, notes, scheduling, account planning) to support forecasting and business visibility.
* Share critical field insights (market trends, competitive intel, partner needs) with leadership to shape product enhancements and go-to-market strategy.
* Represent Sunbit with professionalism and expertise, always focused on helping practices serve more patients through responsible financing solutions.

**﻿What You'll Bring:**

* **﻿**3+ years in field sales, account management, or DSO/practice consulting in the dental industry (highly preferred), medical, healthcare, or other in-office services.
* 3+ years managing a territory and book of business across dental practices and DSOs.
* Demonstrated track record of growing existing accounts through strong relationships, training, data-driven performance conversations, and strategic influence.
* Experience coaching front-line staff and managers, preferably in a workflow-driven or technology-enabled environment.
* Strong business acumen and comfort with performance metrics, including conversion trends, account segmentation, and revenue planning.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; confident leading trainings, business reviews, and group discussions.
* Highly organized with strong time-management, pipeline planning, and territory routing skills.
* A self-motivated, proactive, high-ownership mindset — someone who thrives in a dynamic, fast-growing environment.
* Willingness to travel 50%+ (overnights included).
* Mastery of productivity tools (PowerPoint, Excel, CRM systems)

**﻿Why Choose Sunbit?**

Sunbit is recognized as one of the fastest-growing and most admired fintech companies, earning honors from Inc. 5000 (four consecutive years), Forbes Fintech 50, Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Financial Times, and FinTech Breakthrough for its innovation and impact. The company has also been featured among Newsweek’s Most Loved Workplaces and CB Insights’ Unicorn Companies, reflecting a valuation of $1.1B.

People choose Sunbit for its people-first culture rooted in service, inclusion, and real-world impact. Powered by AI that helps people in life’s critical moments—offering high approvals, speed, and zero fees—Sunbit has achieved proven scale across tens of thousands of merchants and millions of transactions. Its fast, fair, and simple financial products empower consumers and partners alike through clarity and trust.

**﻿The Perks:**

* Join one of LA’s fastest growing startups (2023), A Most Loved Workplace, #576 on the 2023 Inc 5000 list, and Forbes Fintech 50 (2024), #161 on Deloitte Technology Fast 500 list
* Mission driven + empowered + collaborative
* Competitive pay and stock options
* Unlimited PTO
* Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, EAP, FSA, & Maternity Leave
* Newly added HSA and Pet Insurance
* 401K Plan with Matching
* Cell Phone Stipend

**How We Pay:**

* We believe in paying fairly and equitably based on a number of factors including but not limited to previous experience, relevant work history, interview performance, geographical location, internal equity, and expected level of ownership.
* We are targeting a base salary of $110k-140k per year for this role. This role is eligible for commission/ bonus in addition to the base salary
* This role will also be granted company equity via stock options

*Sunbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to provide a professional & welcoming workplace for all employees.*

**﻿Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer**

We’ve been made aware of fraudsters impersonating Sunbit employees during the hiring process. Please note that all official communication will come from an @sunbit.com email address, through our applicant tracking platform @sunbit.comeet-notifications.com or directly via LinkedIn. We will never ask for your age, Social Security number, bank account details, payment of any kind, or other unrelated personal information during the application process.
